**Witnesses:** Mrs. Babocol Sicila

**Date / Time:** October 6, 1980, at approximately 2030 hours (8:30 PM)

**Location:** John A. Macdonald Boulevard, Kingston, Ontario

**Sighting:** 
On the evening of October 6, 1980, at approximately 2030 hours, Mrs. Babocol Sicila of 68 Moran Crescent, Kingston, Ontario, observed an unidentified aerial phenomenon while in the vicinity of John A. Macdonald Boulevard. The weather conditions at the time were reported as cloudy. According to Mrs. Sicila, the object hovered above a line of trees for a duration of approximately two minutes before departing rapidly in a southerly direction.

**Object:** 
The object was described as a large, disk-shaped craft. It displayed a multi-colored appearance consisting of red, white, and blue hues. The witness noted that the object appeared to "twinkle" and featured approximately eight distinct lights arranged on its structure. 

**Investigation / Follow-up:** 
The incident was initially reported to the Ontario Provincial Police and the Kingston City Police. Both agencies reportedly investigated the report but ultimately dismissed the event, characterizing it as a hoax. Consequently, the matter was referred to the military police for further review.

Internal documentation associated with the case file includes a handwritten note—bearing a time reference of "7h 20m C.S.T."—which offers an alternative explanation for the sighting. This note suggests that the planet Venus was exceptionally bright in that specific portion of the sky at the time, implying it may have been the source of the observation. The note further references the National Research Council station at Lygard (noted as being 8 miles south of Darwin) and explicitly states that there was no physical evidence, photographic documentation, or other unusual phenomena to corroborate the witness's account. The file contains a standard administrative filing stamp with routing fields, confirming the formal processing of the report.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_16_-_Pages_45.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 巴博科尔·西西拉夫人 (Mrs. Babocol Sicila)

**日期 / 时间：** 1980年10月6日，约20:30（晚上8:30）

**地点：** 安大略省金斯顿市，约翰·A·麦克唐纳大道 (John A. Macdonald Boulevard)

**目击经过：**
1980年10月6日晚约20:30，居住在安大略省金斯顿市莫兰新月街68号的巴博科尔·西西拉夫人在约翰·A·麦克唐纳大道附近观察到一种不明空中现象。据报告，当时天气多云。据西西拉夫人描述，该物体在树线上方盘旋了约两分钟，随后迅速向南飞离。

**物体描述：**
该物体被描述为一个大型圆盘状飞行器。它呈现出红、白、蓝三种颜色的混合外观。目击者指出，该物体看起来在“闪烁”，其结构上排列着大约八盏明显的灯光。

**调查/后续：**
该事件最初被报告给安大略省省警和金斯顿市警察局。据报道，这两个机构均对此进行了调查，但最终将该事件驳回，定性为恶作剧。随后，此事被移交给宪兵队作进一步审查。

与该案卷相关的内部文件中包含一张手写便条，上面标注了“7h 20m C.S.T.”的时间参考，并为此次目击事件提供了另一种解释。该便条暗示，当时金星在天空的特定区域异常明亮，暗示这可能是目击事件的来源。便条还提到了位于莱加德 (Lygard) 的国家研究委员会观测站（注：位于达尔文以南8英里处），并明确指出没有任何实物证据、摄影记录或其他异常现象来佐证目击者的陈述。该档案包含一个带有路由字段的标准行政归档印章，确认了该报告已进入正式处理流程。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_16_-_Pages_45.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Ed (Edward) Kreutz, Andy Kreutz, Gordon A. MacKenzie.

**Date / Time:** October 18, 1980, between 05:30 and 06:45 hrs.

**Location:** Highway 48, approximately 4 miles east of Davin, Saskatchewan.

**Sighting:** On the morning of October 18, 1980, brothers Ed and Andy Kreutz were driving eastbound on Highway 48. At approximately 05:45 hrs, they observed a light north of the highway, initially mistaking it for a TV tower or an airplane. As they approached within 200–300 feet, they observed the object hovering at an altitude of 200–300 feet. The object featured a blue light on the left side, a red light on the right side, and a red flashing light in the center. When the red flashing light deactivated, a white searchlight—protruding about one foot in diameter—emanated from the center, tracing behind the witnesses' vehicle. 

The object moved alongside the car for approximately 1/8 of a mile before crossing the highway to the south side. The witnesses described the movement as fast, starting and stopping without visible acceleration. The total duration of the sighting was approximately 15 minutes, ending when the object departed rapidly in a southbound direction. The Kreutz brothers did not stop their vehicle due to fear. A McGavin’s Company truck, driven by Gordon A. MacKenzie, was reportedly following the brothers' vehicle at a distance of 1/4 to 1/2 mile. However, upon being interviewed by the RCMP on October 20, 1980, Mr. MacKenzie stated he did not observe anything unusual during his run, though he confirmed he was driving on Highway 48 at the time.

**Object:** The object was described as circular or round with a flat bottom and an oval top, estimated at 25–30 feet in diameter. It featured an arc pattern of lights, including constant blue and red side lights and a central red flashing light. A white searchlight was also observed. The object made no noise, and the witnesses reported no radio interference or mechanical failure in their vehicle.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The RCMP Regina Detachment conducted a thorough investigation, including taking written statements and a sketch from the Kreutz brothers. Cst. R. Gagnon oversaw the documentation. Official inquiries were made with the Regina City Police, the Regina Airport Flight Service Station, the Salt Lake City Terminal Centre, and the Montmartre Detachment (Cst. Lefebvre), all of which yielded negative results for other sightings or flight plans. It was noted that radar services in the area were closed between midnight and 07:00 hrs, and Winnipeg Centre radar coverage did not extend to the location. The investigation concluded that no other reports were filed, and the case file was forwarded to the National Research Council in Ottawa.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_16_-_Pages_45.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 埃德（爱德华）·克鲁兹（Ed (Edward) Kreutz）、安迪·克鲁兹（Andy Kreutz）、戈登·A·麦肯齐（Gordon A. MacKenzie）。

**日期 / 时间：** 1980年10月18日，05:30至06:45之间。

**地点：** 萨斯喀彻温省达文（Davin）以东约4英里处的48号高速公路。

**目击经过：** 1980年10月18日清晨，克鲁兹兄弟（埃德和安迪）正驾车沿48号高速公路向东行驶。大约在05:45，他们观察到公路北侧有一道光，起初误以为是电视塔或飞机。当他们靠近至200至300英尺距离时，发现该物体正悬停在200至300英尺的高度。该物体左侧有一盏蓝灯，右侧有一盏红灯，中心则有一盏闪烁的红灯。当中心闪烁的红灯熄灭后，一个直径约一英尺的白色探照灯从中心射出，并追随着目击者的车辆。

该物体在车旁伴随飞行了约1/8英里，随后横穿公路飞往南侧。目击者描述其移动速度极快，起止瞬间完成，没有明显的加速过程。目击过程持续了约15分钟，最终该物体向南疾驰而去。由于恐惧，克鲁兹兄弟并未停车。据报道，一辆由戈登·A·麦肯齐驾驶的麦加文公司（McGavin’s Company）卡车当时正跟在兄弟俩车后约1/4至1/2英里处。然而，在1980年10月20日接受加拿大皇家骑警（RCMP）采访时，麦肯齐先生表示他在行程中并未观察到任何异常，尽管他确认当时确实行驶在48号公路上。

**物体描述：** 该物体被描述为圆形或圆盘状，底部平坦，顶部呈椭圆形，直径估计为25至30英尺。其上有一组弧形排列的灯光，包括常亮的蓝色和红色侧灯以及中心闪烁的红灯。此外还观察到了一个白色探照灯。该物体飞行时没有发出任何声音，目击者报告称车辆未出现无线电干扰或机械故障。

**调查/后续：** 加拿大皇家骑警里贾纳分局进行了彻底调查，包括获取克鲁兹兄弟的书面陈述及草图。R·加尼翁（R. Gagnon）警官负责监督记录工作。官方分别向里贾纳市警察局、里贾纳机场飞行服务站、盐湖城终端中心以及蒙马特分局（勒费弗尔警官，Cst. Lefebvre）进行了问询，但均未获得其他目击报告或飞行计划记录。调查指出，该地区的雷达服务在午夜至07:00之间处于关闭状态，且温尼伯中心的雷达覆盖范围并未延伸至该地点。调查结论显示没有收到其他相关报告，案件档案被移交至渥太华的国家研究委员会。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_16_-_Pages_45.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Bob Walker, Diane Walker, Rita David (taxi driver), Bruce Bobick (Smithers Airport dispatcher)

**Date / Time:** October 21, 1980; initial sighting reported at approximately 1930 hours, with subsequent observations continuing until approximately 2145 hours.

**Location:** Smithers, British Columbia; specifically near the ridge south of town, the local ski hill, and the peaks of Hudson Bay Mountain.

**Sighting:** On the evening of October 21, 1980, Bob Walker and taxi driver Rita David observed a brightly lit object hovering over a ridge south of Smithers near the local ski hill. Bob Walker initially observed the object at 1930 hours; later, at approximately 2145 hours, he alerted the Terrace Telecom Centre to the sighting while entering Rita David’s taxi to depart for a teaching engagement. Bob Walker reported the object moved in an erratic pattern for roughly five minutes before he left the scene. Diane Walker observed the object for a duration of 30 to 45 minutes, noting that it traversed back and forth from the highest peak of Hudson Bay Mountain, using the peak as a central point. The witnesses reported that the object eventually disappeared after Diane Walker briefly went inside their residence at 3667 First Ave. The RCMP noted that the witnesses appeared sober and credible throughout the investigation.

**Object:** The object was described as a sphere or circular shape that, when moving, took on an inverted dish-like appearance. It emitted a bright white light from its lower half, which was powerful enough to illuminate the mountain area and the snow below. A distinct pinkish glow was observed when the object was stationary. The object exhibited rapid, erratic movement—described as significantly faster than a conventional airplane or helicopter—and was estimated to be at an altitude of 5,000 to 6,500 feet. No sound was reported, and only one object was observed.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The RCMP Smithers Detachment, led by officer J.B. Colville, conducted a thorough follow-up. Officers attended the Walker residence at 2147 hours to interview the complainants and later contacted Rita David by phone. The investigating officer noted clear sky conditions and a lack of light pollution in the area. To rule out conventional aircraft, the RCMP interviewed Smithers Airport dispatcher Bruce Bobick, who confirmed that no planes or helicopters were in the vicinity at the time of the sighting. The RCMP also contacted the Comox Armed Forces Base, which could provide no confirmation of the object. While the RCMP concluded that the witnesses were believable and the object remained unidentified, they noted the possibility of construction activity on the ridge as a potential factor. The case was categorized as (UNORG) and reports were distributed to the CO "E" Division, District 2, and the OC Prince Rupert Sub/Division. No further action was taken.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_16_-_Pages_45.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 鲍勃·沃克 (Bob Walker)、黛安·沃克 (Diane Walker)、丽塔·戴维 (Rita David，出租车司机)、布鲁斯·博比克 (Bruce Bobick，史密瑟斯机场调度员)

**日期 / 时间：** 1980年10月21日；最初目击报告时间约为19:30，后续观测持续至约21:45。

**地点：** 不列颠哥伦比亚省史密瑟斯；具体位于镇南侧山脊、当地滑雪场及哈德逊湾山 (Hudson Bay Mountain) 山峰附近。

**目击经过：** 1980年10月21日晚，鲍勃·沃克和出租车司机丽塔·戴维观察到一个明亮的物体悬浮在史密瑟斯南侧靠近当地滑雪场的山脊上方。鲍勃·沃克于19:30首次观察到该物体；随后在约21:45，他在搭乘丽塔·戴维的出租车准备前往参加教学活动时，向特勒斯电信中心 (Terrace Telecom Centre) 通报了此次目击事件。鲍勃·沃克报告称，该物体在离开现场前以不规则的轨迹移动了约五分钟。黛安·沃克观察该物体的时间长达30至45分钟，她指出该物体以哈德逊湾山的最高峰为中心点，在山峰两侧往返穿梭。据目击者称，在黛安·沃克短暂进入位于第一大道3667号的住所后，该物体最终消失。加拿大皇家骑警 (RCMP) 指出，目击者在整个调查过程中表现清醒且可信。

**物体描述：** 该物体被描述为球形或圆形，在移动时呈现出倒扣碟状的外观。其下半部发出明亮的白光，光线强度足以照亮山体区域及下方的积雪。当物体静止时，观察到了明显的粉红色光晕。该物体表现出快速、不规则的移动——据描述比传统飞机或直升机快得多——估计高度在5,000至6,500英尺之间。未报告任何声音，且仅观察到一个物体。

**调查/后续：** 由警官J.B.科尔维尔 (J.B. Colville) 领导的加拿大皇家骑警史密瑟斯分局进行了彻底的后续调查。警员于21:47前往沃克住所采访了投诉人，随后通过电话联系了丽塔·戴维。调查警官指出，当时天空状况晴朗，该地区没有光污染。为了排除传统飞行器，加拿大皇家骑警采访了史密瑟斯机场调度员布鲁斯·博比克，他证实目击当时附近没有飞机或直升机。加拿大皇家骑警还联系了科莫克斯武装部队基地 (Comox Armed Forces Base)，但对方无法确认该物体。虽然加拿大皇家骑警得出结论认为目击者可信且该物体身份不明，但他们指出山脊上的施工活动可能是潜在因素。该案件被归类为 (UNORG)，报告分发给了“E”分部指挥官、第2区以及鲁珀特王子港分部指挥官。此后未采取进一步行动。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_16_-_Pages_45.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** O'Neil (Morse Detachment RCMP), Norman Gitzel (Retired S/Sgt RCMP), Cst. M. Page, Cst. Todd, Cst. McCulloch, and Major Ron Ailsby (Canadian Armed Forces Reserves).

**Date / Time:** November 4, 1980, at approximately 2100 hours (with a follow-up report at 2135 hours).

**Location:** Herbert, Regina, and Rush Lake, Saskatchewan (specifically: two miles north of Herbert; south side of Regina near TV antennas; and 6 miles east of Rush Lake on Highway 1).

**Sighting:** At approximately 2100 hours, multiple witnesses across Saskatchewan observed a significant aerial event. In the vicinity of Herbert, retired S/Sgt Norman Gitzel and members of the Morse RCMP Detachment observed two white lights in the southwest. These lights were positioned perpendicular to each other and traveled at a high rate of speed in a northeasterly direction. This portion of the sighting lasted approximately 25 seconds before the objects appeared to explode.

Simultaneously, in Regina, Cst. M. Page observed two bright lights approaching from the west near the city’s south-side TV antennas. Cst. Page noted that the lights were positioned one above the other and moved in a parallel formation, traveling east before turning northeast. Cst. Todd and Cst. McCulloch confirmed the sighting via radio contact. Cst. Page initially suspected the objects were meteors, noting they left a trail of light and sparkles before disintegrating and disappearing.

At 2135 hours, Major Ron Ailsby of the Canadian Armed Forces Reserves reported observing the same phenomenon while located 6 miles east of Rush Lake on Highway 1. He viewed the objects at a 25-degree angle, level with the horizon. Major Ailsby initially considered the possibility of an airplane crash or a satellite due to the objects' distinct appearance. The total duration of the observation was reported as between one and one-half minutes. The sky was noted as being clear at the time, and reports indicate that numerous other individuals throughout the city of Regina witnessed the event.

**Object:** The objects were described as two bright lights. Witnesses near Herbert described them as white with long white tails, while Major Ailsby described them as having a bright orange-yellowish color. The objects moved at a high rate of speed, initially appearing parallel or perpendicular to one another. They emitted trails of light and sparkles, and were observed to disintegrate or explode at the end of the sighting.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The event was documented by the RCMP (Morse Detachment) and forwarded to the National Research Council of Canada. Official records include witness statements from RCMP personnel and a Canadian Armed Forces Reserves Major. Weather conditions were noted as clear. The reports acknowledge that the event was widely observed by the general public in the Regina area.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_16_-_Pages_45.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 奥尼尔（O'Neil，莫尔斯分局加拿大皇家骑警）、诺曼·吉策尔（Norman Gitzel，加拿大皇家骑警退休参谋警长）、M·佩奇警官（Cst. M. Page）、托德警官（Cst. Todd）、麦卡洛克警官（Cst. McCulloch）以及罗恩·艾尔斯比少校（Major Ron Ailsby，加拿大武装部队预备役）。

**日期 / 时间：** 1980年11月4日，约21:00（后续报告时间为21:35）。

**地点：** 萨斯喀彻温省的赫伯特（Herbert）、里贾纳（Regina）和拉什湖（Rush Lake）（具体位置：赫伯特以北两英里处；里贾纳南侧靠近电视天线处；以及拉什湖以东6英里的1号高速公路上）。

**目击经过：** 约21:00，萨斯喀彻温省的多名目击者观察到了一起重大的空中事件。在赫伯特附近，退休参谋警长诺曼·吉策尔和莫尔斯分局的加拿大皇家骑警成员观察到西南方向有两个白光。这些光点呈垂直排列，并以极高的速度向东北方向移动。目击过程持续了约25秒，随后物体似乎发生了爆炸。

与此同时，在里贾纳，M·佩奇警官观察到两个明亮的光点从西面靠近该市南侧的电视天线。佩奇警官注意到这两个光点呈上下排列，以平行编队移动，向东飞行后转向东北方向。托德警官和麦卡洛克警官通过无线电联络证实了此次目击。佩奇警官起初怀疑这些物体是流星，并指出它们在解体消失前留下了光迹和火花。

21:35，加拿大武装部队预备役的罗恩·艾尔斯比少校报告称，他在拉什湖以东6英里的1号高速公路上观察到了同样的现象。他以与地平线平齐的25度角观察到了这些物体。由于物体外观独特，艾尔斯比少校起初考虑了飞机坠毁或卫星的可能性。据报告，整个观察过程持续了一分半钟。当时天空晴朗，报告显示里贾纳市的其他许多民众也目击了这一事件。

**物体描述：** 这些物体被描述为两个明亮的光点。赫伯特附近的目击者称其为带有长长白色尾迹的白光，而艾尔斯比少校则描述其为明亮的橙黄色。这些物体以极高的速度移动，起初看起来彼此平行或垂直。它们散发出光迹和火花，并在目击结束时被观察到解体或爆炸。

**调查/后续：** 该事件由加拿大皇家骑警（莫尔斯分局）记录并转交给加拿大国家研究委员会。官方记录包括加拿大皇家骑警人员和一名加拿大武装部队预备役少校的证词。气象条件记录为晴朗。报告承认该事件在里贾纳地区受到了公众的广泛关注。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_16_-_Pages_45.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Carol Dixon, neighbours.

**Date / Time:** November 8, 1980, at 2010 hours.

**Location:** Toronto, Ontario (specifically over Lake Ontario and the C.N. Tower).

**Sighting:** On the evening of November 8, 1980, at approximately 2010 hours, Carol Dixon and several neighbours observed an unidentified object in the skies over Toronto. According to the witnesses, the object was seen moving in north and south directions over Lake Ontario and circling the C.N. Tower. The witnesses reported that the object appeared to disappear and reappear repeatedly over a duration of approximately 1 1/2 hours. Carol Dixon initially attempted to report the sighting to the Department of National Defence, but at that time, no formal report was taken.

**Object:** The object was described by the witnesses as a huge, oblong-shaped craft. It featured a tail of red light, and the entire underside of the object was covered in rows of flashing lights that constantly changed colours. While the witnesses initially perceived the object as an unidentified phenomenon, subsequent investigations by the RCMP identified the object as the *Toronto Sun* advertising airplane. Following this identification, Carol Dixon confirmed that she had seen the same aircraft on several occasions since the incident and realized it was the source of the sighting.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** Following the initial report, the RCMP conducted inquiries with various agencies to determine the nature of the object. These investigations concluded that the object was the *Toronto Sun* advertising airplane. The complainant, Carol Dixon, was contacted by authorities and subsequently acknowledged that the object she and her neighbours observed was indeed the advertising aircraft. Meteorological data recorded for the time of the sighting noted that the weather conditions were overcast with high cloud cover and light rain.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_16_-_Pages_45.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 卡罗尔·迪克森（Carol Dixon）及邻居。

**日期 / 时间：** 1980年11月8日，20:10。

**地点：** 安大略省多伦多（具体位于安大略湖及加拿大国家电视塔上方）。

**目击经过：** 1980年11月8日晚约20:10，卡罗尔·迪克森和几位邻居在多伦多上空观察到一个不明物体。据目击者称，该物体在安大略湖上空南北移动，并绕着加拿大国家电视塔盘旋。目击者报告称，该物体在约一个半小时的时间里反复出现又消失。卡罗尔·迪克森最初试图向国防部报告此次目击事件，但当时并未受理正式报告。

**物体描述：** 目击者将该物体描述为一艘巨大的长方形飞行器。它拖着一条红色的光尾，整个底部布满了不断变换颜色的闪烁灯光。虽然目击者起初认为该物体是一种不明现象，但加拿大皇家骑警（RCMP）随后的调查将其确认为《多伦多太阳报》（Toronto Sun）的广告飞机。在这一身份确认后，卡罗尔·迪克森证实，自该事件发生以来，她曾多次见过同一架飞机，并意识到这就是当时目击事件的来源。

**调查/后续：** 在接到初步报告后，加拿大皇家骑警向多个机构进行了询问，以确定该物体的性质。调查结论显示，该物体为《多伦多太阳报》的广告飞机。当局联系了投诉人卡罗尔·迪克森，她随后承认，她和邻居们观察到的物体确实是那架广告飞机。目击时间段的气象数据显示，当时天气阴沉，有高云覆盖并伴有小雨。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_16_-_Pages_45.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Nellie Marina Simms, Sylvia Lydia Giles, Priscille Ether Drover, Awilda (Welda) Ellen McKay, and Cst. J.D. Smith (investigating officer).

**Date / Time:** November 20–21, 1980, at approximately 23:45 to 00:29 hrs.

**Location:** 6th Avenue, Deer Lake, Newfoundland.

**Sighting:** On the night of November 20, 1980, four women—Nellie Simms, Sylvia Giles, Priscille Drover, and Awilda McKay—were sitting in a parked vehicle on 6th Avenue in front of McKay’s residence following a Salvation Army church meeting. At approximately 23:45 hrs, while the group was talking, they observed a bright light descending rapidly from the sky. The witnesses described the object moving on a slant or angle from west to east. 

Each witness expressed concern that the object was on a collision course with a nearby structure, specifically identifying the home of a Mr. Waldron. The sighting was brief, lasting between one and two seconds. Despite the proximity of the object, which appeared to be at a low altitude, none of the witnesses reported hearing any sound. Following the disappearance of the object, the women exited the vehicle to search the immediate area, fearing a crash, but found no evidence of an impact. Nellie Simms was sufficiently unsettled by the event that she contacted a radio open-line program the following day to inquire if others had witnessed the phenomenon.

**Object:** The object was consistently described as a round, ball-like shape. Estimates of its size varied, ranging from two to three feet in diameter, the size of the moon, or the size of the top of a 45-gallon drum. It was described as glowing a vivid, bright red, likened specifically to the appearance of a car’s brake lights, rather than the appearance of fire. It moved at a very high speed and did not emit any noise.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** RCMP officers, including Cst. J.D. Smith and Cst. Nason, conducted a follow-up investigation at the scene near #9 6th Avenue. Because there was a light covering of fresh snow on the ground, the officers were able to perform a thorough search of the area where the object appeared to descend. No signs of impact, debris, or unusual disturbances were discovered. Official weather reports for the time of the sighting indicated clear skies with 15-mile visibility and scattered cloud cover (3,000 ft scattered, 10,000 ft broken). The reporting officers concluded that the object was likely a meteor that created an optical illusion, appearing larger and closer to the witnesses than it actually was. The officers noted that had an object of the described size truly impacted a residential area, it would have been observed by others or left physical evidence.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_16_-_Pages_45.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 内莉·玛丽娜·西姆斯 (Nellie Marina Simms)、西尔维娅·莉迪亚·贾尔斯 (Sylvia Lydia Giles)、普里西拉·埃瑟·德罗弗 (Priscille Ether Drover)、阿维尔达（韦尔达）·艾伦·麦凯 (Awilda (Welda) Ellen McKay) 以及调查警官 J.D. 史密斯 (Cst. J.D. Smith)。

**日期 / 时间：** 1980年11月20日至21日，大约 23:45 至 00:29。

**地点：** 纽芬兰省迪尔湖 (Deer Lake)，第六大道。

**目击经过：** 1980年11月20日晚，内莉·西姆斯、西尔维娅·贾尔斯、普里西拉·德罗弗和阿维尔达·麦凯四名女性在参加完救世军教会会议后，坐在麦凯住所前第六大道上的一辆停放的汽车里。大约 23:45，当她们正在交谈时，观察到一个明亮的光体从天空中迅速降落。目击者描述该物体正以倾斜的角度从西向东移动。

每位目击者都担心该物体会撞上附近的建筑物，特别是沃尔德伦先生 (Mr. Waldron) 的家。目击过程很短暂，持续了大约一到两秒。尽管该物体看起来高度很低且距离很近，但没有目击者报告听到任何声音。物体消失后，女士们走出车外搜寻周边地区，担心发生坠毁，但没有发现任何撞击的痕迹。内莉·西姆斯对此次事件感到十分不安，以至于她在第二天联系了一个电台热线节目，询问是否还有其他人目击了这一现象。

**物体描述：** 该物体被一致描述为圆形的球状物。对其大小的估计各不相同，范围从直径两到三英尺、月球大小，到 45 加仑油桶顶部的大小不等。它被描述为发出鲜艳明亮的红光，具体被比作汽车刹车灯的样子，而不是火光。它以极高的速度移动，且没有发出任何噪音。

**调查/后续：** 包括 J.D. 史密斯警官和纳森 (Nason) 警官在内的加拿大皇家骑警 (RCMP) 对第六大道 9 号附近的现场进行了后续调查。由于地面覆盖着一层薄薄的新雪，警官们能够对物体似乎降落的区域进行彻底搜查。现场没有发现撞击迹象、碎片或异常扰动。目击时的官方天气报告显示天空晴朗，能见度为 15 英里，有零散云层（3,000 英尺处零散，10,000 英尺处断续）。报告警官得出结论，该物体很可能是一颗流星，产生了视觉错觉，使其看起来比实际更大、更靠近目击者。警官们指出，如果描述中那么大的物体真的撞击了住宅区，它本应被其他人观察到，或者留下物理证据。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_02_-_Pages_30.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Gene Murie NORN, a forestry employee, reported the sighting to Alice HODGES, a Public Health Nurse, who then advised the RCMP.

**Sighting:** On July 16, 1968, between midnight and 12:30 AM, NORN observed an object while walking home on a roadway in Fort Resolution. He was alone at the time.

**Object:** The witness described the object as looking like a fireball, similar to a flare, with sparks following behind. The sparks were green and red, resembling an arc welder. The object had a jelly bean shape, emitted smoke like a jet, and appeared to be "breathing" or flaring. It traveled straight northeast at a very high speed, faster than a jet, and made no noise. It had no wings or tail fin. The object crossed the open space in approximately 50 to 60 seconds before disappearing into the clouds.

**Aftermath:** The RCMP officer interviewed NORN and noted that he was a steady, truthful individual with experience in aircraft spotting. NORN compared the object to a B-61 or Matador pilotless aircraft, noting that the primary differences were the bright light/fire at the rear, the presence of sparks, and the lack of noise.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_02_-_Pages_30.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 林业雇员 Gene Murie NORN 向公共卫生护士 Alice HODGES 报告了此次目击事件，随后由护士通知了加拿大皇家骑警 (RCMP)。

**目击：** 1968 年 7 月 16 日午夜至凌晨 12:30 之间，NORN 在 Fort Resolution 的道路上行走时独自目击了该物体。

**物体：** 目击者将其描述为像火球或信号弹，尾部伴有火花。火花呈绿色和红色，类似于电弧焊。物体呈果冻豆形状，像喷气式飞机一样排放烟雾，看起来像在“呼吸”或闪烁。它以极快的速度向东北方向直线飞行，速度超过喷气式飞机，且没有任何声音。该物体没有机翼或尾翼。它在消失于云层之前，用了大约 50 到 60 秒穿过空旷区域。

**后续：** 加拿大皇家骑警警官采访了 NORN，并指出他是一位稳重、诚实且具有飞机识别经验的人。NORN 将该物体与 B-61 或 Matador 无人驾驶飞机进行了比较，指出主要区别在于物体后部有明亮的光或火、有大量火花，且没有噪音。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mrs. Geneva Ready, Mr. Andrew Ready (retired Deputy Chief of the Kingston Police Force), Frances Ready (also recorded as Frances Read), Mr. Paul Faucher, and Mrs. Paul Faucher.

**Date / Time:** January 22, 1978. Two distinct timeframes were reported: 1400–1500 hours (Kingston) and 1650 hours / 9:50 Z (Hwy 417).

**Location:** Two separate locations: the vicinity of Ravensview (Gates Boulevard and Poplar Road, north of Highway 2, Kingston, Ontario) and Highway 417 between Montreal and Ottawa (approximately 30 miles from Ottawa).

**Sighting:** 
The event involves two separate reports occurring on the same day. In the first incident, Mrs. Geneva Ready, Mr. Andrew Ready, and Frances Ready were traveling south in a car near Ravensview, Kingston. Between 1400 and 1500 hours, they observed two objects hovering over a sewage plant located approximately two miles east of their position. The witnesses watched the objects for approximately 90 seconds before they departed at a 45-degree angle at a very high rate of speed.

In the second incident, Mr. and Mrs. Paul Faucher reported observing objects while traveling on Highway 417 between Montreal and Ottawa at 1650 hours. They observed these objects for a duration of 14 minutes before they disappeared.

**Object:** 
The objects reported in Kingston were described as two triangles joined base-to-base, resembling a kite. They were dull grey in color, lacked any glow or external lights, and hovered at an estimated altitude of 500 feet, comparable to the height of local helicopters. 

The objects reported by the Fauchers on Highway 417 were described as stationary, round, and larger than stars. They were yellow-orange in color and appeared to form elongated chains before vanishing.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** 
The Kingston sighting was reported to the Military Police at CFB Kingston on January 25, 1978. The report highlights the credibility of Mr. Andrew Ready, noting his background as a retired Deputy Chief of the Kingston Police Force with 10 years of service. 

The Highway 417 report was received via telephone on January 23, 1978. Official follow-up notes suggest that the objects observed by the Fauchers were likely the contrail of a jet visible just before sunset. This conclusion was supported by the observer’s own admission that they had witnessed a similar phenomenon at the same time the previous evening.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 吉内瓦·雷迪夫人（Mrs. Geneva Ready）、安德鲁·雷迪先生（Mr. Andrew Ready，金斯顿警察局退休副局长）、弗朗西斯·雷迪（Frances Ready，记录中也写作 Frances Read）、保罗·福谢先生（Mr. Paul Faucher）及保罗·福谢夫人（Mrs. Paul Faucher）。

**日期 / 时间：** 1978年1月22日。报告了两个不同的时间段：14:00–15:00（金斯顿）和16:50 / 9:50 Z（417号高速公路）。

**地点：** 两个独立的地点：雷文斯维尤（Ravensview）附近（安大略省金斯顿，2号高速公路以北的盖茨大道与白杨路交汇处）以及蒙特利尔至渥太华之间的417号高速公路（距渥太华约30英里处）。

**目击经过：**
该事件涉及同一天发生的两次独立报告。在第一起事件中，吉内瓦·雷迪夫人、安德鲁·雷迪先生和弗朗西斯·雷迪正乘车在金斯顿雷文斯维尤附近向南行驶。在14:00至15:00之间，他们观察到两个物体悬停在距离他们位置以东约两英里的污水处理厂上方。目击者观察这些物体约90秒，随后它们以45度角高速离去。

在第二起事件中，保罗·福谢夫妇报告称，他们在16:50驾车行驶在蒙特利尔至渥太华之间的417号高速公路上时观察到了物体。他们观察这些物体持续了14分钟，随后物体消失。

**物体描述：**
金斯顿目击事件中的物体被描述为两个底对底连接的三角形，类似于风筝。它们呈暗灰色，没有任何光泽或外部灯光，悬停在估计500英尺的高度，与当地直升机的飞行高度相当。

福谢夫妇在417号高速公路上报告的物体被描述为静止的圆形，比星星更大。它们呈黄橙色，在消失前似乎形成了细长的链状。

**调查/后续：**
金斯顿的目击事件于1978年1月25日报告给金斯顿加拿大军队基地（CFB Kingston）的宪兵队。报告强调了安德鲁·雷迪先生的可信度，指出他曾担任金斯顿警察局副局长，拥有10年的服役背景。

417号高速公路的报告于1978年1月23日通过电话接收。官方后续记录显示，福谢夫妇观察到的物体很可能是日落前可见的喷气式飞机凝结尾迹。这一结论得到了观察者本人的证实，他们承认在前一天同一时间也目击过类似的现象。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Lucien Lacroix, Estelle Arcan

**Date / Time:** January 23, 1978; duration of 20 minutes

**Location:** Robertsonville, Quebec (specifically noting Lucien Lacroix of Notre Dame Nord, Robertsonville, and Estelle Arcan of Thetford Mines)

**Sighting:** On the evening of January 23, 1978, witnesses Lucien Lacroix and Estelle Arcan observed a significant aerial phenomenon consisting of a large group of over 150 bright lights. The lights were organized into small, distinct formations. The entire group was observed moving in a consistent direction from east to west. The witnesses noted that the lights appeared to be distributed at varying altitudes, positioned above the cloud layer. The observation lasted for a total duration of 20 minutes.

**Object:** The objects were described as white in color and were noted to be slightly brighter than a typical star. Regarding their physical behavior and characteristics, there was no sound reported by the witnesses, nor were there any bursts of light or other sudden changes in intensity observed during the 20-minute event.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The documentation consists of two pages (141 and 142) detailing the accounts of Lucien Lacroix and Estelle Arcan. The records confirm the witnesses' locations—Lacroix residing in Notre Dame Nord, Robertsonville, and Arcan in Thetford Mines—and provide a consistent narrative regarding the number of objects, their formation, and the lack of auditory or explosive phenomena. No further official investigation notes, weather data, or sketches were provided in the source text beyond these witness accounts.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 吕西安·拉克鲁瓦 (Lucien Lacroix)、埃斯特尔·阿尔坎 (Estelle Arcan)

**日期 / 时间：** 1978年1月23日；持续时间20分钟

**地点：** 魁北克省罗伯逊维尔 (Robertsonville)（特别注明：吕西安·拉克鲁瓦居住于罗伯逊维尔的圣母北区 (Notre Dame Nord)，埃斯特尔·阿尔坎居住于塞特福德矿区 (Thetford Mines)）

**目击经过：** 1978年1月23日晚，目击者吕西安·拉克鲁瓦和埃斯特尔·阿尔坎观察到一种重大的空中现象，由超过150个明亮光点组成。这些光点排列成若干个小型、独特的编队。整个光点群被观察到正从东向西一致移动。目击者指出，这些光点似乎分布在不同的高度，位于云层上方。整个观测过程持续了20分钟。

**物体描述：** 这些物体被描述为白色，亮度略高于普通恒星。关于其物理行为和特征，目击者报告称没有任何声音，在20分钟的事件过程中，也没有观察到任何闪光或其他强度的突然变化。

**调查/后续：** 相关档案包含两页（第141页和142页），详细记录了吕西安·拉克鲁瓦和埃斯特尔·阿尔坎的陈述。记录确认了目击者的所在地——拉克鲁瓦居住在罗伯逊维尔的圣母北区，阿尔坎居住在塞特福德矿区——并提供了关于物体数量、编队方式以及缺乏声音或爆炸现象的一致叙述。除这些目击者陈述外，原始文本中未提供进一步的官方调查记录、气象数据或草图。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** S/Cst Keesak Nowdluk, his wife, Levi Nowdluk, Patrick Lyall, Martha Kilabuk, and David Igushak.

**Sighting:** On January 25, 1978, between 6:35 PM and 6:37 PM MST, five witnesses observed an object in the sky. The sky was clear with no obstructions and a full moon was present.

**Aftermath:** The duration of the observation was a full 2 minutes. The report was filed by the Spence Bay Detachment of the RCMP via telex to the National Research Council Meteor Centre in Ottawa.

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mr. Danny Gravelle, MCpl Schleichauf (reporting officer), Mrs. Margaret Cole, Mr. Douglas Cole.

**Date / Time:** February 3, 1978 (with conflicting reports noting February 2, February 3, and February 22; times recorded include 0115Z, 2230Z, and 2300Z).

**Location:** East shore of Lake Nipissing, North Bay, Ontario.

**Sighting:** This event involves two distinct sets of observations reported from the east shore of Lake Nipissing. 

In the first account, Mr. Danny Gravelle reported observing two square orange lights positioned close to the ice. These objects traveled toward the city of North Bay, climbed to an altitude of 2,000 feet, and subsequently disappeared. While some documentation lists the date as February 2 or February 22, the primary official record places the event on February 3, 1978, at 0230Z.

In the second account, Mrs. Margaret Cole and her husband, Mr. Douglas Cole, observed a phenomenon at 0115Z on February 3, 1978. They described a large, reddish-orange ball of fire hovering at an altitude of approximately 400 yards. Unlike the objects reported by Mr. Gravelle, the Coles observed their object remaining completely motionless for a duration of approximately five minutes. They noted that the object behaved similarly to a large flare, eventually breaking apart until it was no longer visible.

**Object:** 
*   **Gravelle Observation:** Two square, orange-colored lights. Movement was characterized by a transition from a low position near the ice to a climb of 2,000 feet before vanishing.
*   **Cole Observation:** A single, large, reddish-orange ball of fire. It was observed at an altitude of 400 yards. It remained stationary for five minutes before disintegrating/breaking up and disappearing.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** 
The reports were handled by the Military Police (MP) on duty, specifically MCpl Schleichauf (also spelled Schleinauf in some documents). Mr. Gravelle’s report was formally transmitted from 22 NRHQ North Bay to the National Research Council (NRC) Ottawa, specifically directed to the NRC Radio and Electrical Engineering Division. Weather conditions at the time of the sightings were consistently reported as cloudy. Despite the official relay of information to the NRC, some internal notes indicate the incident was not reported elsewhere. No further physical evidence or follow-up investigations beyond the initial MP relay were documented in the provided files.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 丹尼·格拉维尔（Danny Gravelle）先生、施莱考夫（Schleichauf）中士（报告警官）、玛格丽特·科尔（Margaret Cole）女士、道格拉斯·科尔（Douglas Cole）先生。

**日期 / 时间：** 1978年2月3日（另有报告称日期为2月2日、2月3日及2月22日；记录时间包括0115Z、2230Z及2300Z）。

**地点：** 安大略省北湾（North Bay），尼皮辛湖（Lake Nipissing）东岸。

**目击经过：** 此事件涉及两组在尼皮辛湖东岸报告的不同观测记录。

在第一起报告中，丹尼·格拉维尔先生称观察到两个靠近冰面的方形橙色光点。这些物体向北湾市方向移动，随后爬升至2000英尺的高度，最终消失。尽管部分文件将日期列为2月2日或2月22日，但主要的官方记录将该事件定于1978年2月3日0230Z。

在第二起报告中，玛格丽特·科尔女士及其丈夫道格拉斯·科尔先生于1978年2月3日0115Z观察到一种现象。他们描述称，一个巨大的红橙色火球悬浮在约400码的高度。与格拉维尔先生报告的物体不同，科尔夫妇观察到的物体在约五分钟的时间内完全静止不动。他们指出，该物体的表现类似于一枚大型照明弹，最终分裂直至消失不见。

**物体描述：**
*   **格拉维尔的观测：** 两个方形的橙色光点。其运动特征是从靠近冰面的低位爬升至2000英尺高度，随后消失。
*   **科尔夫妇的观测：** 一个巨大的红橙色火球。该物体被观测到悬浮在400码的高度，静止停留了五分钟，随后解体/分裂并消失。

**调查/后续：**
这些报告由值班宪兵（MP）处理，具体负责警官为施莱考夫中士（部分文件中拼写为Schleinauf）。格拉维尔先生的报告由北湾第22北美防空司令部（NRHQ）正式转交至渥太华的国家研究委员会（NRC），并特别呈送给NRC无线电与电气工程部门。目击发生时的天气状况一致报告为多云。尽管信息已正式转达至NRC，但部分内部记录显示该事件未在其他渠道进行报告。在提供的档案中，除最初的宪兵转报外，未记录到进一步的物证或后续调查。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Brian Mosychuk.

**Sighting:** On February 3, 1978, at 0330Z, the witness reported seeing a lighted object, vehicle-sized, with blue lights at both ends approaching from the northwest. It hovered over him and emitted a rumbling sound. A light emerged from the top, curved downward, and shone at his feet. The witness leaned backward to avoid the light, felt heat at his feet, and then ran. When he looked back, the object was speeding in a northeast direction, leaving a red trail.

**Object:** A vehicle-sized object with blue lights at both ends, emitting a rumbling sound and a downward-curving light beam.

**Aftermath:** The witness's father investigated and found a melted spot in the snow. City police checked the site and found a melted hole approximately 70 cm in diameter. A piece of snow from the area, along with carbon spots, was brought to a hangar for a contamination check. The sample was found to be clean. A police officer from the Londonderry station noted there was surprisingly little carbon around the hole, considering the amount of melt, if it had been caused by a car warming up. A sample of the snow was kept in a freezer at the command post.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 布莱恩·莫西丘克 (Brian Mosychuk)。

**日期：** 1978年2月3日，03:30Z（协调世界时）。

**地点：** 未提供具体地点名称。

**目击经过：** 目击者报告称，看到一个车辆大小的发光物体从西北方向靠近，两端带有蓝光。该物体悬停在他上方，并发出隆隆声。物体顶部射出一道光束，向下弯曲并照向他的脚部。目击者向后仰以避开光束，感到脚部有热感，随即逃离。当他回头看时，该物体正向东北方向疾驰而去，留下一道红色的轨迹。

**物体描述：** 一个车辆大小的物体，两端带有蓝光，发出隆隆声，并能射出向下弯曲的光束。

**调查/后续：** 目击者的父亲进行了调查，发现雪地上有一个融化点。市警察检查了现场，发现了一个直径约70厘米的融化坑。该区域的一块雪样连同碳斑被带到机库进行污染检查，结果显示样本未受污染。伦敦德里 (Londonderry) 警局的一名警官指出，考虑到融化程度，如果是由汽车暖车造成的，现场残留的碳量少得令人惊讶。雪样样本被保存在指挥所的冷冻柜中。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Rita Eleanor Toupin (also spelled Elenore), Alain Bruce Toupin.

**Date / Time:** February 5, 1978, at approximately 4:00 A.M. to 4:10 A.M.

**Location:** St. Leon, Manitoba (observed from the residence patio/dining room).

**Sighting:** On the morning of February 5, 1978, Rita Eleanor Toupin was awake and looking west from her patio when she observed a bright, pulsating light in the sky. Concerned for her son, Alain, who had not yet returned home, she monitored the object for approximately 10 minutes before he arrived. Upon his return, she alerted him to the sighting. Alain observed the object for 15 to 40 minutes (accounts vary by report). The witnesses noted the sky was clear and cold, and they specifically stated that no Northern Lights were visible to them. Rita described the object’s movement as an "arrow-head angle," characterized by a rising and falling motion as it traveled westward. Both witnesses confirmed the object did not resemble a star and changed its position relative to the stars. No noise or exhaust trails were observed.

**Object:** The object was described as a craft resembling two saucer plates with a wafer-like section in between. This central wafer featured clearly distinguishable vertical partitions. A bright red light revolved in sequence from left to right around the saucer. When the red light was on the "blind side," the object appeared in colors of white, cream, yellow, and pale aqua green. Alain utilized 7x50 binoculars and a Marksman telescope (achromatic coated lens, 20x30x40x60x D-60 mm) set at 20x magnification to view the craft. He reported that the object did not move rapidly and remained above eye level.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The sighting was reported to the RCMP, and Constable B.T. Burnett (badge #28744) of the Winnipeg Detachment conducted an investigation at the Toupin residence on February 8, 1978. Alain Toupin provided a rough sketch of the object. Constable Burnett noted a discrepancy regarding the Northern Lights: while the witnesses claimed none were present, the officer had observed strong Northern Lights in the northern sky until 2:00 A.M. that morning. He concluded that the living room extension of the house likely blocked the witnesses' view of the northern sky, accounting for the discrepancy. The case was forwarded to the Manitou Detachment and the NRC Meteor Centre in Ottawa (referenced as message 78/6). The file was initially marked as "Still Under Investigation" (S.U.I.) by the Winnipeg Detachment.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 丽塔·埃莉诺·图潘（Rita Eleanor Toupin，拼写亦作Elenore），阿兰·布鲁斯·图潘（Alain Bruce Toupin）。

**日期 / 时间：** 1978年2月5日，大约凌晨4:00至4:10。

**地点：** 马尼托巴省圣里昂（从住宅露台/餐厅观察）。

**目击经过：** 1978年2月5日清晨，丽塔·埃莉诺·图潘醒来后从露台向西望去，发现天空中有一个明亮且不断闪烁的光点。由于担心尚未回家的儿子阿兰，她观察了该物体约10分钟，直到他抵达。阿兰回来后，她提醒他注意这一现象。阿兰对该物体进行了15至40分钟的观察（不同报告说法不一）。目击者指出当时天空晴朗且寒冷，并明确表示他们没有看到任何极光。丽塔描述该物体的移动轨迹呈“箭头状角度”，在向西飞行时伴有起伏运动。两位目击者均确认该物体不像星星，且相对于恒星的位置发生了改变。观察过程中未发现任何噪音或尾迹。

**物体描述：** 该物体被描述为一艘类似于两个碟子中间夹着一片晶圆状结构的飞行器。这个中央“晶圆”部分有清晰可辨的垂直隔板。一盏明亮的红灯围绕着碟子从左向右依次旋转。当红灯转到“盲区”时，物体呈现出白色、奶油色、黄色和淡水绿色。阿兰使用了7x50双筒望远镜和一台倍率设为20倍的Marksman望远镜（消色差镀膜镜片，20x30x40x60x D-60 mm）来观察该飞行器。他报告称，该物体移动并不迅速，且始终保持在视线水平以上。

**调查/后续：** 该目击事件被报告给了加拿大皇家骑警（RCMP），温尼伯分局的B.T.伯内特警官（B.T. Burnett，警号#28744）于1978年2月8日在图潘家中进行了调查。阿兰·图潘提供了该物体的草图。伯内特警官注意到关于极光描述的差异：尽管目击者声称当时没有极光，但警官本人在当天凌晨2:00之前曾在北方天空观察到强烈的极光。他推断，房屋的客厅延伸部分可能遮挡了目击者对北方天空的视野，从而导致了这一差异。该案件被转交至马尼图分局和渥太华的国家研究委员会（NRC）流星中心（编号为78/6）。该档案最初被温尼伯分局标记为“仍在调查中”（S.U.I.）。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mr. Norman Lewthwaite, J. Sh... (surname partially obscured)

**Date / Time:** February 10, 1978 (Lewthwaite sighting); "about a week + half ago" relative to a March 5, 1952, stamped note (J. Sh... sighting)

**Location:** 63 Ferris Lane, Unit A4, Barrie, Ontario (Lewthwaite); Broadway and Fillmore, Buffalo, New York (J. Sh...)

**Sighting:** 
The primary event, reported by Mr. Norman Lewthwaite of Barrie, Ontario, occurred on February 10, 1978. Mr. Lewthwaite observed an unidentified object for a duration of approximately 30 minutes. The object was positioned at a "quite high" altitude. 

A separate, secondary report is documented in a handwritten note from a witness identified as J. Sh... of 827 Fillmore, Buffalo, N.Y. This witness reported seeing a "huge strip" in the evening at the intersection of Broadway and Fillmore. The witness noted that the object appeared "traffic-related" in nature but explicitly stated their belief that the phenomenon originated "from outer space."

**Object:** 
Mr. Lewthwaite described his observed object as being light blue and purple, intermixed with red. No specific shape or sound was recorded for this object, only its high altitude and 30-minute duration. 

The object reported by J. Sh... was described as a "huge strip." No specific color, sound, movement, or duration was provided for this sighting, other than the witness's subjective assessment of its extraterrestrial origin.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** 
The report regarding Mr. Lewthwaite’s sighting was processed through official military and government channels. It was transmitted from CFB Borden to the National Defence Operations Centre (NDOC) in Ottawa, the Rescue Coordination Centre (RCCWC), and the National Research Council (NRC) of Canada’s Radio and Electrical Engineering Division. 

The note provided by J. Sh... contains file markings including "N78/28" and bears a National Research Council of Canada stamp. Notably, this specific page also carries a stamped date of "MAR 5 1952," suggesting it may have been misfiled or cross-referenced within the NRC archives alongside the 1978 Barrie case file. No further investigation results or follow-up actions are documented for either report.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 诺曼·卢斯韦特（Norman Lewthwaite）先生，J. Sh...（姓氏部分模糊）

**日期 / 时间：** 1978年2月10日（卢斯韦特目击事件）；相对于1952年3月5日的盖章日期“约一周半前”（J. Sh...目击事件）

**地点：** 安大略省巴里市费里斯巷63号A4单元（卢斯韦特）；纽约州布法罗市百老汇大道与菲尔莫尔大道交叉口（J. Sh...）

**目击经过：**
主要事件由安大略省巴里市的诺曼·卢斯韦特先生报告，发生于1978年2月10日。卢斯韦特先生观察到一个不明物体，持续时间约为30分钟。该物体处于“相当高”的海拔高度。

另一份独立的辅助报告记录在一位名为J. Sh...的目击者（地址为纽约州布法罗市菲尔莫尔大道827号）的手写便条中。该目击者报告称，在傍晚时分于百老汇大道和菲尔莫尔大道的交叉口看到了一条“巨大的长条状物”。目击者指出该物体看起来与“交通相关”，但明确表示其相信该现象起源于“外太空”。

**物体描述：**
卢斯韦特先生描述他观察到的物体呈浅蓝色和紫色，并夹杂着红色。关于该物体没有记录到具体的形状或声音，仅记录了其高海拔和30分钟的持续时间。

J. Sh...报告的物体被描述为“巨大的长条状物”。除了目击者对其外星起源的主观判断外，没有提供关于该目击事件的具体颜色、声音、运动方式或持续时间。

**调查/后续：**
关于卢斯韦特先生目击事件的报告通过官方军事和政府渠道进行了处理。报告从博登加拿大武装部队基地（CFB Borden）传达至渥太华的国家国防作战中心（NDOC）、救援协调中心（RCCWC）以及加拿大国家研究委员会（NRC）的无线电与电气工程部。

J. Sh...提供的便条包含“N78/28”等文件标记，并盖有加拿大国家研究委员会的印章。值得注意的是，该页纸上还盖有“1952年3月5日”的日期戳，这表明它可能被错误归档，或是在国家研究委员会的档案中与1978年的巴里案例文件进行了交叉引用。目前没有关于这两起报告的进一步调查结果或后续行动记录。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** William MacIsaac and several residents in the area.

**Sighting:** On February 9, 1978, a complaint was received regarding a red object seen in the sky. The object reportedly landed near the home of William MacIsaac.

**Object:** A red object that was observed in the sky and appeared to land.

**Aftermath:** The object could not be located. Several residents in different areas witnessed the incident, with reports centered around the Grand Codroy Park in Codroy, Newfoundland. The RCMP in Channel-Port aux Basques reported the incident to the NRC Meteor Centre in Ottawa for information and action.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** William MacIsaac 以及该地区的几位居民。

**目击：** 1978年2月9日，收到一份关于天空中出现红色物体的投诉。据报道，该物体降落在 William MacIsaac 的住所附近。

**物体：** 一个在天空中被观察到并似乎降落的红色物体。

**后续：** 该物体未能被找到。该地区的几位居民目击了这一事件，报告集中在纽芬兰省科德罗伊（Codroy）的大科德罗伊公园（Grand Codroy Park）。Channel-Port aux Basques 的皇家骑警（RCMP）将此事件报告给渥太华的加拿大国家研究委员会（NRC）流星中心，以供参考并采取行动。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mr. Brent Gardner, Mr. Steve McNally (CJCI Radio)

**Date / Time:** February 13, 1978, at 12:0850Z

**Location:** South of the Prince George Airport, Prince George, British Columbia (observed from the top of the Inn of the North)

**Sighting:** On February 13, 1978, at 12:0850Z, a sighting report was initiated by Mr. Brent Gardner, who observed an unidentified object located south of the Prince George airport. The object remained stationary for a duration of 45 minutes. Mr. Steve McNally, representing CJCI Radio, also observed the object from his vantage point at the top of the Inn of the North. Both witnesses noted that while the object was positioned in the general direction of the Prince George airport, its altitude was significantly too high to be associated with airport operations or local air traffic.

**Object:** The object was described as having a distinct triangular shape. It featured a configuration of flashing lights in green, red, and white. No specific sound or movement (other than its stationary nature) was reported.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** Upon receiving the report from Mr. Gardner, Mr. Steve McNally of CJCI Radio conducted an immediate follow-up by contacting the Prince George airport radio operator. The operator confirmed that they were unable to see any object from their specific location at the airport. Following this, Mr. McNally relayed the details of the sighting to the Canadian Forces Station (CFS) at Baldy Hughes for further official awareness. No further explanation for the object was provided in the documentation.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 布伦特·加德纳先生 (Mr. Brent Gardner)、史蒂夫·麦克纳利先生 (Mr. Steve McNally，CJCI电台)

**日期 / 时间：** 1978年2月13日，12:0850Z

**地点：** 不列颠哥伦比亚省乔治王子城，乔治王子机场以南（从北方旅馆顶层观测）

**目击经过：** 1978年2月13日12:0850Z，布伦特·加德纳先生发起了一份目击报告，他观察到一个位于乔治王子机场以南的不明物体。该物体保持静止状态长达45分钟。代表CJCI电台的史蒂夫·麦克纳利先生也从他位于北方旅馆顶层的观测点观察到了该物体。两位目击者均指出，虽然该物体位于乔治王子机场的大致方向，但其高度明显过高，不可能是机场运营或当地空中交通的一部分。

**物体描述：** 该物体被描述为具有明显的三角形外观。其上配置有绿色、红色和白色的闪烁灯光。除保持静止外，未报告有任何特定的声音或移动。

**调查/后续：** 在接到加德纳先生的报告后，CJCI电台的史蒂夫·麦克纳利先生立即进行了后续跟进，联系了乔治王子机场的无线电操作员。操作员确认，从他们位于机场的具体位置无法看到任何物体。此后，麦克纳利先生将目击详情转达给了位于鲍尔迪休斯 (Baldy Hughes) 的加拿大武装部队站 (CFS)，以引起官方的进一步关注。相关文件中未提供关于该物体的进一步解释。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mr. D. Matthews

**Date / Time:** February 12, 1978, at 0330Z

**Location:** Innisgillis Drive, Oromocto, New Brunswick

**Sighting:** 
On February 12, 1978, at 0330Z, Mr. D. Matthews, a resident of Innisgillis Drive in Oromocto, New Brunswick, observed an unidentified aerial phenomenon. While facing south, Mr. Matthews spotted an object positioned 20 degrees above the horizon. The object remained stationary throughout the duration of the sighting, which lasted for a total of 15 minutes. Mr. Matthews noted that the object appeared significantly brighter than the surrounding stars in the night sky.

**Object:** 
The object was described as oblong in shape and yellow in color. It exhibited a distinct light pattern, alternating between red and blue, with a yellow override. The object remained stationary at an elevation of 20 degrees above the horizon for the entire 15-minute duration of the observation.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** 
The sighting report was formally processed and transmitted by the 22 NORAD Region at North Bay to the National Research Council (NRC) in Ottawa. Official documentation notes that a corrected date-time group for the transmission was to be issued once received from the North Bay facility. No further atmospheric or physical explanations were provided in the available documentation.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** D. 马修斯先生 (Mr. D. Matthews)

**日期 / 时间：** 1978年2月12日，0330Z

**地点：** 新不伦瑞克省奥罗莫克托，因尼斯吉利斯大道 (Innisgillis Drive, Oromocto, New Brunswick)

**目击经过：** 
1978年2月12日0330Z，居住在新不伦瑞克省奥罗莫克托因尼斯吉利斯大道的 D. 马修斯先生观测到一种不明空中现象。马修斯先生面向南方时，发现一个位于地平线上方20度位置的物体。该物体在整个目击过程中保持静止，持续时间总计15分钟。马修斯先生指出，该物体看起来比夜空中周围的恒星要明亮得多。

**物体描述：** 
该物体被描述为长方形，呈黄色。它表现出一种独特的光模式，在红色和蓝色之间交替闪烁，并伴有黄色覆盖。在整个15分钟的观测过程中，该物体始终静止在地平线上方20度的高度。

**调查/后续：** 
该目击报告由位于北湾 (North Bay) 的北美防空司令部 (NORAD) 第22区域正式处理，并转交至渥太华的国家研究委员会 (NRC)。官方文件记录显示，一旦从北湾设施收到更正后的日期-时间组，将予以发布。现有文件中未提供进一步的大气或物理学解释。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mrs. Vern Sandberg

**Date / Time:** February 14, 1978, at 0505Z (Note: One document contains a clerical variation of 095Z, but 0505Z is the consistent primary timestamp).

**Location:** 4th St., Sheho, Saskatchewan

**Sighting:** On the morning of February 14, 1978, Mrs. Vern Sandberg, a resident of 4th Street in Sheho, Saskatchewan, observed an unidentified aerial phenomenon. The sighting began at 0505Z and lasted for a total duration of one hour. Throughout this period, Mrs. Sandberg observed the object moving at a very slow pace. The altitude of the object remained unknown to the witness throughout the duration of the sighting.

**Object:** The object was described as being round in shape. Its most prominent visual features were flickering green and red lights. The object exhibited very slow movement across the sky. No specific sound or size dimensions were recorded in the provided documentation, and the altitude remained undetermined.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** Official follow-up procedures were conducted by authorities to determine if the object had been tracked by military or civil aviation systems. The investigation resulted in a "negative pickup" on both search and height radar systems, indicating that no corresponding radar return was detected in the area at the time of the sighting. One page of the file includes a handwritten or typed administrative note to "disregard that" regarding the radar findings, though the context for this instruction is not explicitly detailed in the provided records.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 弗恩·桑德伯格夫人 (Mrs. Vern Sandberg)

**日期 / 时间：** 1978年2月14日，05:05Z（注：一份文件中存在095Z的笔误，但05:05Z是主要且一致的时间戳）。

**地点：** 萨斯喀彻温省谢霍市 (Sheho, Saskatchewan) 第四街

**目击经过：** 1978年2月14日清晨，居住在萨斯喀彻温省谢霍市第四街的弗恩·桑德伯格夫人观察到一种不明空中现象。目击事件始于05:05Z，总持续时间为一小时。在此期间，桑德伯格夫人观察到该物体以非常缓慢的速度移动。在整个目击过程中，目击者无法确定该物体的高度。

**物体描述：** 该物体被描述为圆形。其最显著的视觉特征是闪烁的绿色和红色灯光。该物体在天空中呈现出非常缓慢的移动状态。提供的文档中未记录该物体的具体声音或尺寸大小，高度也未确定。

**调查/后续：** 当局进行了官方后续程序，以确定该物体是否曾被军事或民用航空系统追踪。调查结果显示，搜索雷达和高度雷达系统均显示“无回波”，表明在目击当时该区域未检测到相应的雷达回波。档案中有一页包含一条手写或打印的行政备注，要求“忽略该项”雷达调查结果，但所提供的记录中并未详细说明此项指示的背景。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Grant Edward Law

**Date / Time:** February 17, 1978, at approximately 12:25 a.m.

**Location:** Drayton Valley, Alberta. The witness was at his home (located one mile east of the sighting location). The sighting occurred approximately two miles east of Drayton Valley and 1/4 mile south on Buck Creek Road.

**Sighting:** On February 17, 1978, at 12:25 a.m., Grant Edward Law was outside his home in Drayton Valley feeding his dogs when he observed a large, bright flash. Upon looking upward, he witnessed two additional flashes originating from the southeast of his house. The witness estimated the flashes occurred at a distance of approximately one mile, appearing above the tree line. After witnessing the event, Law went inside his house to report the incident to CFB Namao. Upon returning outside shortly thereafter, the object was gone.

**Object:** The witness described the object as a large bulb of orange and white light. The primary observation was a series of three distinct, bright flashes occurring in the southeastern sky.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** Following the report to CFB Namao, the RCMP conducted a patrol of the area; however, they observed nothing unusual. It was noted that the night was clear with little to no cloud cover. On February 21, 1978, the witness provided a formal statement to the RCMP office. 

In their follow-up, the RCMP noted that a North Western Utilities Pumping Station and an AMOCO Petroleums of Canada natural gas plant—which features a flare stack—are located in the exact direction where the witness observed the flashes. It was the official opinion of the reporting officer that the "bright flashes" were caused by an excess amount of gases being burned off at the plant's flare stack.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 格兰特·爱德华·劳 (Grant Edward Law)

**日期 / 时间：** 1978年2月17日，凌晨约12:25

**地点：** 阿尔伯塔省德雷顿谷 (Drayton Valley)。目击者当时位于其家中（距离目击地点以东一英里处）。目击事件发生在德雷顿谷以东约两英里，巴克溪路 (Buck Creek Road) 以南1/4英里处。

**目击经过：** 1978年2月17日凌晨12:25，格兰特·爱德华·劳在德雷顿谷的家中户外喂狗时，观察到一道巨大的强光闪烁。他抬头望去，又目睹了另外两道源自他家东南方向的闪光。目击者估计这些闪光距离他约一英里，出现在树线之上。目击事件后，劳回到屋内向纳马奥加拿大武装部队基地 (CFB Namao) 报告了此事。不久后他再次回到户外时，该物体已消失不见。

**物体描述：** 目击者将该物体描述为一个巨大的橙白色光球。主要的观测结果是天空中出现的连续三次明显的强光闪烁。

**调查/后续：** 在向纳马奥加拿大武装部队基地报告后，加拿大皇家骑警 (RCMP) 对该地区进行了巡逻，但未发现任何异常。据记录，当晚天气晴朗，几乎没有云层。1978年2月21日，目击者向加拿大皇家骑警办公室提交了一份正式陈述。

在后续调查中，加拿大皇家骑警指出，西北公用事业公司 (North Western Utilities) 的泵站和加拿大阿莫科石油公司 (AMOCO Petroleums of Canada) 的天然气厂（配有火炬塔）正位于目击者观察到闪光的方位。负责警官的官方意见认为，这些“强光闪烁”是由该工厂火炬塔燃烧过剩气体所引起的。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mrs. Linda Dedieu (also recorded as Mrs. Linda Bedieu)

**Date / Time:** February 17, 1978, at 0650Z

**Location:** 393 Atlantic Drive, Reserve Mines, Nova Scotia

**Sighting:** On the morning of February 17, 1978, at 0650Z, a sighting occurred in the vicinity of 393 Atlantic Drive in Reserve Mines, Nova Scotia. The witness, identified in the records as both Mrs. Linda Dedieu and Mrs. Linda Bedieu, observed a single, unidentified aerial phenomenon. The witness reported that the object was positioned approximately 15 degrees above the horizon. Throughout the duration of the sighting, which lasted for a total of 10 minutes, the object was observed moving in a North-Northwest (NNW) direction. The witness noted a distinct change in the object's apparent size during the event: it initially appeared to be the size of a 50-cent piece, but subsequently diminished to the size of a 10-cent piece before eventually disappearing from view.

**Object:** The object was described as a single, round, gold-colored entity. It maintained a consistent shape throughout the observation, though its apparent size changed significantly, shrinking from the visual equivalent of a 50-cent piece to that of a 10-cent piece. The object was observed at an elevation of 15 degrees above the horizon and exhibited movement in a North-Northwest direction. The total duration of the sighting was 10 minutes. No sound or other physical characteristics were reported.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** Following the report of the sighting, the information was formally transmitted from CFS (Canadian Forces Station) Sydney to the National Defence Operations Centre in Ottawa. The report was also forwarded to the National Research Council for further review. No additional details or investigative findings were recorded in the provided documentation.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 琳达·德迪厄夫人（Mrs. Linda Dedieu，记录中亦写作琳达·贝迪厄夫人 Mrs. Linda Bedieu）

**日期 / 时间：** 1978年2月17日，0650Z（协调世界时）

**地点：** 新斯科舍省，里瑟夫矿区（Reserve Mines），大西洋大道393号

**目击经过：** 1978年2月17日上午0650Z，在新斯科舍省里瑟夫矿区大西洋大道393号附近发生了一起目击事件。目击者（记录中姓名分别为琳达·德迪厄夫人和琳达·贝迪厄夫人）观察到一个单一的不明空中现象。据目击者称，该物体位于地平线上方约15度处。整个目击过程持续了10分钟，期间该物体向北-西北（NNW）方向移动。目击者注意到该物体在事件期间视直径发生了明显变化：起初看起来有50分硬币大小，随后缩小至10分硬币大小，最终消失在视野中。

**物体描述：** 该物体被描述为一个单一的、圆形的、金色的实体。在整个观察过程中，其形状保持一致，但视直径发生了显著变化，从视觉上的50分硬币大小缩小至10分硬币大小。该物体被观察到位于地平线上方15度处，并向北-西北方向移动。目击总时长为10分钟。未报告有声音或其他物理特征。

**调查/后续：** 在收到目击报告后，相关信息由加拿大武装部队悉尼站（CFS Sydney）正式传达至渥太华的国家国防作战中心。该报告随后被转交至加拿大国家研究委员会（National Research Council）进行进一步审查。现有文件中未记录任何其他细节或调查结果。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mr. Gerald Uwiera (of 16 6220 17th Ave SE, Calgary, Alberta)

**Date / Time:** February 20, 1978, at 1800Z (201800Z)

**Location:** Highway 7, near Flaxcomb, Saskatchewan

**Sighting:** On February 20, 1978, at approximately 1800Z, Mr. Gerald Uwiera was driving his vehicle on Highway 7 near Flaxcomb, Saskatchewan. During his transit, he observed an unidentified object flying over an approaching truck. The object exhibited a distinct "bobbing" motion, moving up and down in the air. As the two trucks neared one another, the object flew over the approaching truck and passed directly between the two vehicles. Mr. Uwiera noted that the total duration of the sighting was approximately one minute. Following the event, Mr. Uwiera initiated efforts to identify and contact the driver of the other truck involved in the encounter.

**Object:** The object was described as round in shape and approximately the size of a large car. Its appearance was dark, likely brown, and it was surrounded by an orange, multicoloured glow. The object emitted a fairly loud sound, which the witness characterized as likely being high-pitched. Regarding its movement, the object was observed bobbing up and down before passing between the two vehicles and continuing along the path of the approaching truck.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The documentation consists of multiple reports detailing the same event. The primary investigation notes focus on the electromagnetic interference experienced by the witness. As the object passed over Mr. Uwiera’s vehicle, his radio, tape deck, and CB radio ceased functioning. Once the object had traveled approximately two blocks past his position, all electrical equipment resumed normal operation. Mr. Uwiera’s contact information (16 6220 17th Ave SE, Calgary, Alberta) was recorded as part of the official file, and the investigation noted his ongoing attempts to locate the driver of the second truck to corroborate the sighting.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** Gerald Uwiera 先生（地址：16 6220 17th Ave SE, Calgary, Alberta）

**日期 / 时间：** 1978年2月20日，1800Z（协调世界时）

**地点：** 萨斯喀彻温省弗拉克斯科姆（Flaxcomb）附近的7号高速公路

**目击经过：** 1978年2月20日大约1800Z，Gerald Uwiera 先生正驾车行驶在萨斯喀彻温省弗拉克斯科姆附近的7号高速公路上。行驶途中，他观察到一个不明飞行物飞越了一辆迎面而来的卡车。该物体呈现出明显的“上下起伏”运动。当两辆卡车靠近时，该物体飞过迎面而来的那辆卡车，并直接从两车之间穿过。Uwiera 先生指出，整个目击过程持续了大约一分钟。事件发生后，Uwiera 先生开始尝试寻找并联系参与此次遭遇的另一辆卡车的司机。

**物体描述：** 该物体被描述为圆形，大小约相当于一辆大型汽车。其外观呈深色（可能是棕色），周围环绕着橙色及多种颜色的光芒。该物体发出相当大的声响，目击者将其描述为可能是高频音。关于其运动方式，该物体在穿过两车之间并沿着迎面卡车的行驶方向继续前进之前，被观察到在空中上下起伏。

**调查/后续：** 相关档案包含多份详细记录同一事件的报告。初步调查记录重点关注了目击者所经历的电磁干扰。当该物体飞过 Uwiera 先生的车辆上方时，他的收音机、磁带播放机和CB无线电台均停止了工作。当该物体飞离他所在位置约两个街区后，所有电子设备恢复了正常运行。Uwiera 先生的联系方式（16 6220 17th Ave SE, Calgary, Alberta）已被记录在案，调查记录中也提到了他为寻找第二辆卡车司机以证实此次目击事件所做的持续努力。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Two individuals (one named, one anonymous friend/civilian)

**Date / Time:** February 20, 1978, at 7:30 PM MST

**Location:** Highway Number 2, near Albright and Beaverlodge, Alberta

**Sighting:** On the evening of February 20, 1978, two individuals were traveling in a truck in a northwesterly direction along Highway #2. While driving near the Albright and Beaverlodge area, they observed a mysterious light positioned straight ahead of them in the sky. The witnesses described the sky as overcast, with no stars visible at the time of the sighting. According to the accounts, the light was positioned at a 35-degree angle in the air. The object remained visible for approximately one minute, during which time it appeared to hover. Following this duration, the light dulled, faded, and eventually disappeared from view.

**Object:** The object was described as a bright light with an intensity comparable to a high-beam headlight. In terms of size, it was estimated to be approximately one-third the size of a full moon. The object was observed at a distance of roughly one-half mile. No specific sound or complex structural details were reported, as the object appeared primarily as a singular, intense light source.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The sighting was reported to the Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP). Upon receiving the report, the RCMP conducted an inquiry and noted that there were no other reports of similar sightings in the area for that date. One of the witnesses specifically requested that their identity remain anonymous in local newspapers. Following the initial documentation, the RCMP forwarded a copy of the official report to the National Research Council (NRC) in Ottawa for further review.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 两人（一人具名，另一人为匿名平民朋友）

**日期 / 时间：** 1978年2月20日，山区标准时间（MST）晚上7:30

**地点：** 阿尔伯塔省奥尔布赖特（Albright）与比弗洛奇（Beaverlodge）附近的2号高速公路

**目击经过：** 1978年2月20日晚，两人正驾驶一辆卡车沿2号高速公路向西北方向行驶。当行驶至奥尔布赖特和比弗洛奇附近时，他们观察到前方天空出现了一道神秘的光。目击者描述当时天空阴沉，看不到星星。据描述，该光点位于空中35度角的位置。物体保持可见状态约一分钟，期间似乎处于悬停状态。随后，光线变暗、减弱，最终消失在视野中。

**物体描述：** 该物体被描述为一道亮度堪比汽车远光灯的强光。据估计，其大小约为满月的三分之一。观察距离约为半英里。由于该物体主要表现为单一的强光源，因此未报告任何特定的声音或复杂的结构细节。

**调查/后续：** 该目击事件被报告给了加拿大皇家骑警（RCMP）。加拿大皇家骑警在接到报告后进行了调查，并指出当天该地区没有其他类似的目击报告。其中一名目击者特别要求在当地报纸上对其身份保密。在完成初步记录后，加拿大皇家骑警将官方报告的副本转交给了位于渥太华的加拿大国家研究委员会（NRC）进行进一步审查。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Judith Ann Comerford (also referred to as Judy Ann Comerford), Diana A. Gail Comerford (also referred to as Diana Gail Coinerford), and Elizabeth Ann Parker (also referred to as Elizabeth Parkes).

**Date / Time:** February 25, 1978. Observations occurred between approximately 7:30 PM and 11:00 PM, with the primary sighting window reported between 9:30 PM and 10:30 PM.

**Location:** Highway No. 5, between Hay River and Pine Point, Northwest Territories (specifically noted between Mile 10 and Mile 34, and near the railroad tracks).

**Sighting:** On the evening of February 25, 1978, the three witnesses were traveling by car from Hay River to Pine Point. The sky was generally clear with visible Northern Lights. Shortly after crossing the railroad tracks on Highway 5, the witnesses observed a large, glowing object. Elizabeth Parker and Judith Comerford reported that the car radio faded and became fuzzy as they approached the object, leading them to turn it off. 

The witnesses observed the object for approximately 30 to 45 minutes. It was seen hovering in clearings, moving between the trees, and appearing both above and below the tree line. The object remained on the left side or in front of the vehicle, never appearing behind them. At one point, the object moved onto the road, forcing the driver to slow down to avoid a collision. Diana Comerford described the object moving up, circling, and changing positions relative to the trees and road. While the witnesses were adamant that the object was not the moon, some accounts note that as the object’s color shifted to pale yellow, it eventually appeared to "become" or merge with the moon upon their arrival at the junction of Highway 5 and Highway 6.

**Object:** The object was described as "very large" and oval-shaped. It was initially a bright, glowing reddish-orange color, with Elizabeth Parker noting a ring of the same color around it. It later transitioned to a pale yellow or whitish color. The object was silent and capable of both rapid movement and hovering.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** Cst. D.A. McLeod of the Pine Point RCMP detachment conducted the investigation. He contacted Aeradio in Hay River and Fort Smith, as well as Captain D. Watkins of the Department of National Defence (DND) in Yellowknife; all confirmed no aircraft were in the area. An RCMP patrol of the route on February 26 found nothing unusual. Cpl. McLeod noted that while no other reports were received, the witnesses were considered reliable. A telex was sent to the National Research Council (NRC) in Ottawa, and the formal report was forwarded to 'G' Division on March 18, 1978. Written statements were signed by the witnesses on February 26, 1978, at 12:40 AM.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 朱迪丝·安·科默福德（Judith Ann Comerford，又称朱迪·安·科默福德/Judy Ann Comerford）、戴安娜·A·盖尔·科默福德（Diana A. Gail Comerford，又称戴安娜·盖尔·科伊纳福德/Diana Gail Coinerford）以及伊丽莎白·安·帕克（Elizabeth Ann Parker，又称伊丽莎白·帕克斯/Elizabeth Parkes）。

**日期 / 时间：** 1978年2月25日。观测时间约为晚上7:30至11:00，主要目击时段报告为晚上9:30至10:30之间。

**地点：** 西北地区海河（Hay River）至松点（Pine Point）之间的5号公路（具体位置标注在10英里至34英里路标之间，靠近铁轨处）。

**目击经过：** 1978年2月25日晚，三名目击者正驾车从海河前往松点。当时天空晴朗，可见北极光。在穿过5号公路的铁轨后不久，目击者观察到一个巨大的发光物体。伊丽莎白·帕克和朱迪丝·科默福德报告称，当她们靠近该物体时，车载收音机信号减弱并出现杂音，导致她们不得不将其关闭。

目击者观察该物体约30至45分钟。它被发现悬停在空地上，在树木间穿梭，并时而出现在树线之上，时而出现在树线之下。该物体始终保持在车辆左侧或前方，从未出现在她们身后。在某一时刻，该物体移动到了公路上，迫使驾驶员减速以避免碰撞。戴安娜·科默福德描述称，该物体向上移动、盘旋，并相对于树木和道路不断变换位置。尽管目击者坚称该物体并非月亮，但一些记录指出，当物体颜色转变为淡黄色时，在她们抵达5号公路与6号公路交汇处时，它最终看起来“变成了”月亮或与月亮融为一体。

**物体描述：** 该物体被描述为“非常巨大”且呈椭圆形。起初它呈现出明亮的红橙色光芒，伊丽莎白·帕克注意到其周围有一个同色的光环。随后它转变为淡黄色或白色。该物体全程静音，具备快速移动和悬停的能力。

**调查/后续：** 松点皇家加拿大骑警（RCMP）分局的D.A.麦克劳德（D.A. McLeod）警员负责了此项调查。他联系了海河和史密斯堡（Fort Smith）的航空无线电部门（Aeradio），以及黄刀镇（Yellowknife）国防部（DND）的D.沃特金斯（D. Watkins）上尉；各方均确认当时该区域没有飞机活动。RCMP于2月26日对该路线进行了巡逻，未发现任何异常。麦克劳德下士指出，虽然没有收到其他报告，但目击者被认为是可靠的。一份电传被发送至渥太华的国家研究委员会（NRC），正式报告于1978年3月18日转交给“G”分部。目击者于1978年2月26日凌晨12:40签署了书面陈述。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Gary Fortin (also referred to as Gaby Fortin), his wife, two sons, and daughter.

**Date / Time:** February 26, 1978 (Note: Page 215 contains a clerical error listing the date as February 6, 1978; the event is officially recorded as February 26, 1978), at 0850Z.

**Location:** 2690 Green Valley Drive, Sudbury, Ontario.

**Sighting:** On February 26, 1978, at 0850Z, the Fortin family—consisting of Gary (Gaby) Fortin, his wife, their two sons, and their daughter—were standing outside near their residence at 2690 Green Valley Drive in Sudbury. The atmospheric conditions were described as clear with slight hazing, allowing for high visibility of the stars. The family observed an unidentified object for a duration of three to five minutes. The object traveled from the south toward an easterly direction at an estimated altitude of 2,000 feet. After traversing this path, the object performed a sudden maneuver, shooting straight upward before disappearing from view.

**Object:** The object was described as oblong in shape and very small in size. It appeared whitish in color and was noted for being "very bright." The witnesses specifically remarked that the object did not display any standard aviation lights or characteristics typical of conventional aircraft.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The sighting was documented and subsequently reported by Canadian Forces Station (CFS) Falconbridge. The official report was forwarded to the National Research Council (NRC) Radio and Electrical Engineering Division for further review.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 加里·福廷（Gary Fortin，也被称为加比·福廷 Gaby Fortin）、他的妻子、两个儿子及一个女儿。

**日期 / 时间：** 1978年2月26日，0850Z（注：第215页存在笔误，将日期写为1978年2月6日；该事件的官方记录日期为1978年2月26日）。

**地点：** 安大略省萨德伯里市，格林谷大道2690号（2690 Green Valley Drive, Sudbury, Ontario）。

**目击经过：** 1978年2月26日0850Z，福廷一家——包括加里（加比）·福廷、他的妻子、两个儿子和女儿——正站在位于萨德伯里市格林谷大道2690号的住所外。据描述，当时大气条件晴朗，仅有轻微薄雾，星空清晰可见。这家人观察到一个不明物体，持续时间为三到五分钟。该物体从南方朝东方飞行，估计高度为2000英尺。在完成这段航程后，该物体突然做出一个机动动作，径直向上冲去，随后消失在视野中。

**物体描述：** 该物体被描述为长方形，体积非常小。它呈现白色，且被特别指出“非常明亮”。目击者明确表示，该物体没有显示出任何标准航空灯光，也不具备常规飞行器的特征。

**调查/后续：** 此次目击事件由加拿大武装部队法尔肯布里奇站（CFS Falconbridge）记录并随后上报。官方报告被转交给加拿大国家研究委员会（NRC）无线电与电气工程部进行进一步审查。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mr. Edwin Price of 425 2th Ave N.W., Calgary, Alta.

**Sighting:** On February 7, 1978, in clear and sunny weather, Mr. Price was at Bowness Park in Calgary. While at a stop sign, he applied his car brakes and the car stopped. When he attempted to continue, the car would not move, although the engine was running. He observed in his rear-view mirror an old car, pea green in color, approximately a 1947 model, weaving behind him. He could only make out the outline of a driver and something black that also seemed to be in the cab. The old car then turned off onto a side road, and Mr. Price's car was able to move forward. Mr. Price then drove toward Bowness Park, and the same old car almost forced him off the road while crossing the Bowness Bridge. He attempted to locate the car again but could not. The first sighting lasted 2 minutes, and the second sighting lasted 30 seconds.

**Object:** An old, pea green car, approximately a 1947 model.

**Aftermath:** The report confirms Mr. Price exists. Mr. Price stated he would not repeat or report this to the local police. No further action is expected.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Edwin Price 先生，居住于阿尔伯塔省卡尔加里市 425 2th Ave N.W.。

**目击：** 1978 年 2 月 7 日，天气晴朗，Price 先生在卡尔加里的鲍内斯公园（Bowness Park）。当他在停车标志处踩下刹车后，车辆停下。随后他试图继续行驶，但车辆无法移动，尽管引擎仍在运转。他在后视镜中看到一辆豌豆绿色的旧车（约 1947 年款）在他身后摇晃。他只能辨认出驾驶员的轮廓，以及车厢内似乎还有某种黑色的东西。那辆旧车随后转入侧路，Price 先生的车才得以继续前行。随后 Price 先生开车前往鲍内斯公园，在经过鲍内斯桥时，同一辆旧车几乎将他逼出路面。他试图再次寻找该车，但未能找到。第一次目击持续了 2 分钟，第二次目击持续了 30 秒。

**物体：** 一辆豌豆绿色的旧车，约 1947 年款。

**后续：** 报告确认了 Price 先生的存在。Price 先生表示他不会再提及此事，也不会向当地警方报告。预计不会有进一步行动。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** M. Laberge and M. Michel Gregoire.

**Sighting:** The witnesses were traveling by car in a westerly direction on Chemin Filteau near Route 20 when they observed an unidentified flying object at approximately 23:00 on February 27, 1978.

**Object:** The object was described as a luminous UFO with three colors: red, white, and yellow. It was non-flashing and observed at an altitude of 1000 feet above a wooded area located between the St. Lawrence River and Chemin Filteau.

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Timothy Kenney, Daniel (Danny) Critch, Randy Frederick Moores, Larry George Parsons, Louise Wilton, S-Cst. Smith (RCMP pilot), Mr. Anderson (Sealand Helicopters pilot), and various RCMP members stationed at Deer Lake and Corner Brook.

**Date / Time:** February 3, 1978; sightings reported between 10:00 PM and 11:00 PM.

**Location:** Wiltondale, Birchy Head, Rocky Harbour, Woody Point, Lomond, and the Table Mountains area, Newfoundland.

**Sighting:** On the night of February 3, 1978, multiple witnesses across the Wiltondale and Birchy Head region observed a significant aerial event. At approximately 10:00 PM, Randy Moores and Larry Parsons, located at Pike’s Garage in Birchy Head, observed a large fireball that illuminated the entire community for a split second. They reported the object descended straight down behind Crow Cliff toward the Table Mountains. 

Simultaneously, RCMP members in Deer Lake and Corner Brook noted the sky lighting up in the direction of Rocky Harbour. At 10:30 PM, Timothy Kenney, Daniel Critch, and Louise Wilton, positioned on a hill in Wiltondale, witnessed a sudden, intense white light. Kenney described the light as moving across the sky for two to three seconds before falling straight down toward Woody Point. Critch, who was on a ski-doo, described the illumination as being so bright it felt as though someone were standing over him with a powerful light. 

While some witnesses reported the object traveling south and disappearing behind hills, others observed it falling vertically. The event was followed by auditory phenomena: Moores and Parsons reported a loud "clap of thunder" one to two seconds after the object vanished. Kenney, Critch, and Wilton reported hearing two distinct explosions, separated by a few seconds, occurring four to five minutes after the light disappeared. These sounds were described as sharp, like thunder rather than a rumble, and appeared to originate from the direction of the Woody Point and Lomond area.

**Object:** The object was consistently described as a large fireball or ball of fire. Size estimates varied, ranging from the size of a "Volkswagen" or a car/truck to as large as "two tandem trucks put together" or "larger than a full moon." Colors reported included white, red, orange, and blue, with several witnesses noting a trailing blue flame or blue streaks. The object was generally round in shape and possessed enough luminosity to illuminate the surrounding hills and landscape.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The RCMP conducted an extensive investigation, including ground searches and aerial patrols. S-Cst. Smith (RCMP) and Mr. Anderson (Sealand Helicopters) performed aerial sweeps of the area but found no evidence of a crash site or debris. Wildlife patrols in Gros Morne National Park also failed to locate any physical evidence. 

Cpl. H.R. Miller of the Rocky Harbour Detachment concluded the file, noting that no further witnesses were located and no information of value was recovered. The RCMP contacted Prof. R.H. MacNeill of the National Research Council (NRC) and requested public reports via local radio, though no calls were received. Copies of all reports were forwarded to Prof. MacNeill in Ottawa for further review.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 蒂莫西·肯尼 (Timothy Kenney)、丹尼尔（丹尼）·克里奇 (Daniel (Danny) Critch)、兰迪·弗雷德里克·穆尔斯 (Randy Frederick Moores)、拉里·乔治·帕森斯 (Larry George Parsons)、路易丝·威尔顿 (Louise Wilton)、史密斯高级警员 (S-Cst. Smith，加拿大皇家骑警飞行员)、安德森先生 (Mr. Anderson，海陆直升机公司飞行员)，以及驻扎在鹿湖 (Deer Lake) 和科纳布鲁克 (Corner Brook) 的多名加拿大皇家骑警成员。

**日期 / 时间：** 1978年2月3日；目击报告时间介于晚上10:00至11:00之间。

**地点：** 纽芬兰省的威尔顿代尔 (Wiltondale)、伯奇角 (Birchy Head)、洛基港 (Rocky Harbour)、伍迪角 (Woody Point)、洛蒙德 (Lomond) 以及桌山 (Table Mountains) 地区。

**目击经过：** 1978年2月3日晚，威尔顿代尔和伯奇角地区的众多目击者观察到了一起重大的空中事件。晚上10:00左右，位于伯奇角派克车库 (Pike’s Garage) 的兰迪·穆尔斯和拉里·帕森斯观察到一个巨大的火球，它在瞬间照亮了整个社区。他们报告称，该物体在克劳崖 (Crow Cliff) 后方径直坠向桌山方向。

与此同时，位于鹿湖和科纳布鲁克的加拿大皇家骑警成员注意到洛基港方向的天空被照亮。晚上10:30，位于威尔顿代尔一座小山上的蒂莫西·肯尼、丹尼尔·克里奇和路易丝·威尔顿目睹了一道突如其来的强烈白光。肯尼描述称，这道光在天空中移动了两到三秒，随后径直坠向伍迪角方向。当时正骑着雪地摩托的克里奇形容那光芒极其耀眼，感觉就像有人拿着强光灯站在他头顶上方一样。

尽管一些目击者报告称该物体向南飞行并消失在山后，但其他人则观察到它垂直坠落。事件发生后伴随有听觉现象：穆尔斯和帕森斯报告称，在物体消失一到两秒后听到了一声巨大的“雷鸣”。肯尼、克里奇和威尔顿则报告称，在光芒消失四到五分钟后，听到了两次间隔几秒的明显爆炸声。这些声音被描述为尖锐的雷鸣声，而非沉闷的隆隆声，且听起来源自伍迪角和洛蒙德地区。

**物体描述：** 该物体被一致描述为一个巨大的火球。对其大小的估计各不相同，从“大众汽车”或轿车/卡车大小，到“两辆串联卡车拼在一起”或“比满月还大”不等。报告的颜色包括白色、红色、橙色和蓝色，几位目击者注意到其后方拖着蓝色火焰或蓝色条纹。该物体形状通常呈圆形，亮度足以照亮周围的山丘和地貌。

**调查/后续：** 加拿大皇家骑警进行了广泛的调查，包括地面搜寻和空中巡逻。史密斯高级警员（加拿大皇家骑警）和安德森先生（海陆直升机公司）对该地区进行了空中扫视，但未发现任何坠机现场或残骸的证据。格罗斯莫讷国家公园 (Gros Morne National Park) 的野生动物巡逻队也未能找到任何实物证据。

洛基港分局的H.R.米勒下士 (Cpl. H.R. Miller) 结案时指出，未再发现其他目击者，也未获得有价值的信息。加拿大皇家骑警联系了国家研究委员会 (NRC) 的R.H.麦克尼尔教授 (Prof. R.H. MacNeill)，并通过当地广播请求公众提供报告，但未收到任何来电。所有报告的副本均已转发至渥太华的麦克尼尔教授处以供进一步审查。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_12_-_Pages_33.report_summary:

**Location:** Gannon Road, near Kings Auto Body Shop, Sydney, NS

**Sighting:** 
The sighting involved two witnesses, Mrs. Leroy and her son-in-law, Mr. Edward King, who were traveling by vehicle along Gannon Road in the vicinity of Kings Auto Body Shop. According to the accounts provided, the witnesses observed a single, unidentified object that manifested solely as a light. The sighting lasted for a total duration of 20 minutes, which the witnesses described as occurring in two distinct ten-minute intervals. During this time, the object was observed moving back and forth across the road on two separate occasions. The witnesses reported that the object changed its light patterns throughout the duration of the event. No sound was associated with the object at any point during the sighting.

**Object:** 
The object was described as appearing only as a light, lacking a discernible solid structure. It displayed a multi-colored sequence of red, green, and yellow. Regarding its movement, the object traversed the road back and forth twice. The total duration of the observation was 20 minutes, characterized by two ten-minute intervals of activity. There was no sound reported in connection with the object.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** 
The documentation provided consists of two pages (225 and 226) detailing the same event. While the case file title identifies the event as the "Sydney NS March 1 1978 sighting," the internal report documentation lists the date of the occurrence as March 8, 1975, at 0220Z. The records confirm that the witnesses were interviewed regarding their experience on Gannon Road, and the reports consistently note the absence of any auditory phenomena during the sighting. No further official investigation notes, weather data, or sketches were provided in the summary of these specific pages.
