CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Keith Blakeney Jr. (also referred to as Keith Flakeney, Jr.), Keith Blakeney Sr.

**Date / Time:** February 8, 1980; between 20:40 and 20:50 AST.

**Location:** Trans-Canada Highway (Highway #1), Maugerville, New Brunswick (approximately one-quarter mile east of the witness's residence).

**Sighting:** On the evening of February 8, 1980, 14-year-old Keith Blakeney Jr. was walking in a westerly direction along the Trans-Canada Highway in Maugerville, NB. The weather conditions were noted as clear with no clouds and a dark moon. At approximately 20:40 to 20:50 AST, the witness observed an aerial phenomenon directly overhead. The witness, described by authorities as a sensible youth who would not fabricate stories for attention, arrived home in a frightened and "shook up" state to report the event to his parents, specifically his father, Keith Blakeney Sr.

**Object:** The object was described as approximately two feet in diameter. While one account describes it as round, another specifies it was oval-shaped. The object was bright bluish-green in color and featured a "cloud-reflecting effect" surrounding it. It moved at a very high rate of speed from south to north. The object maintained a low altitude, eventually disappearing behind trees on the north side of the highway. The duration of the sighting was brief, lasting only a few seconds. No noise was associated with the object’s movement.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The sighting was reported to the Fredericton RCMP detachment, with Cpl. Art Spray assigned as the investigating member. Following the report, the RCMP contacted Air Traffic Control at the Fredericton Airport, who confirmed there were no unusual occurrences or air traffic in the area that night. A telex regarding the incident was sent to the National Research Council. Official documentation of the case includes a stamp identifying the object as a "possible meteor."
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 小基思·布莱克尼（Keith Blakeney Jr.，亦被称为 Keith Flakeney, Jr.）、老基思·布莱克尼（Keith Blakeney Sr.）

**日期/时间：** 1980年2月8日；大西洋标准时间（AST）20:40至20:50之间。

**地点：** 加拿大横贯公路（1号公路），新不伦瑞克省莫格维尔（Maugerville）（位于目击者住所东侧约四分之一英里处）。

**目击经过：** 1980年2月8日晚，14岁的小基思·布莱克尼正沿着新不伦瑞克省莫格维尔的加拿大横贯公路向西行走。当时天气晴朗，无云，月色昏暗。在大西洋标准时间20:40至20:50左右，目击者观察到头顶上方出现了一种空中现象。据当局描述，该目击者是一名理智的少年，不会为了博取关注而编造故事。他回到家时处于惊恐和“心神不宁”的状态，并向父母，特别是他的父亲老基思·布莱克尼报告了此事。

**物体描述：** 该物体被描述为直径约两英尺。虽然有一份报告称其为圆形，但另一份报告明确指出它是椭圆形的。该物体呈明亮的蓝绿色，周围带有“云层反射效应”。它以极高的速度从南向北移动。该物体保持低空飞行，最终消失在公路北侧的树木后方。目击持续时间很短，仅几秒钟。物体的移动过程中没有伴随任何噪音。

**调查/后续：** 该目击事件被报告给了弗雷德里克顿皇家加拿大骑警（RCMP）分局，由阿特·斯普雷（Art Spray）下士负责调查。报告发出后，皇家骑警联系了弗雷德里克顿机场的空中交通管制部门，对方确认当晚该地区没有异常情况或空中交通活动。一份关于此事件的电传被发送至加拿大国家研究委员会。该案件的官方文件中盖有印章，将该物体标识为“可能的流星”。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Miss Peggy Glazer, Lori Glazer, and Margo McLaren.

**Date / Time:** February 6, 1980 (initial sighting); February 10, 1980 (subsequent travel/observation).

**Location:** Market Mall, Northwest Calgary, Alberta; 49th Street and 40th Avenue NW, Calgary, Alberta; Highway 1A near Cochrane, Alberta.

**Sighting:** The event began on February 6, 1980, over the Market Mall area in Northwest Calgary, where the witnesses observed an object heading in a northeasterly direction. The sighting lasted approximately 5 minutes during this initial encounter. On February 10, 1980, the witnesses were traveling by car from 49th Street and 40th Avenue NW in Calgary toward Highway 1A near Cochrane, Alberta. Throughout this journey, the witnesses reported that the object appeared to follow their vehicle; it would move when they moved and stop whenever they brought their car to a halt. The witnesses exited their vehicle at one point to investigate whether the light was a reflection, but they confirmed it was not. The duration of the event on February 10 was approximately 2 hours.

**Object:** The object was described as having a distinct yellowish-orange glow and a luminosity that made it brighter than all other objects in the sky. When stationary, the object appeared to have a triangular shape, though its form became indefinite or undefined when in motion. Regarding altitude, the object was estimated to be between 500 and 1,000 feet while over the city, and between 100 and 200 feet while in the country near Cochrane. No sounds were reported by the witnesses at any point during the sightings. The object appeared to land in the vicinity of Highway 1A and Cochrane.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The sighting was formally reported to the Calgary City Police, who acknowledged the report and indicated that they would conduct an investigation into the matter. No further official findings or weather data were provided in the summary documentation.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 佩吉·格雷泽 (Peggy Glazer)、洛里·格雷泽 (Lori Glazer) 和玛戈·麦克拉伦 (Margo McLaren)。

**日期 / 时间：** 1980年2月6日（首次目击）；1980年2月10日（后续行程/观察）。

**地点：** 阿尔伯塔省卡尔加里西北部的市场购物中心 (Market Mall)；卡尔加里西北区第49街与第40大道；阿尔伯塔省科克伦 (Cochrane) 附近的1A号高速公路。

**目击经过：** 事件始于1980年2月6日，地点位于卡尔加里西北部的市场购物中心上空，目击者观察到一个物体正向东北方向移动。此次初步接触持续了约5分钟。1980年2月10日，目击者乘车从卡尔加里西北区第49街与第40大道出发，前往阿尔伯塔省科克伦附近的1A号高速公路。在整个行程中，目击者称该物体似乎一直在跟随他们的车辆；当他们移动时，物体也随之移动；当他们停车时，物体也随之停止。目击者曾一度下车查看该光点是否为反光，但确认并非如此。2月10日的事件持续时间约为2小时。

**物体描述：** 该物体被描述为发出独特的黄橙色光芒，其亮度超过了天空中所有其他物体。当静止时，该物体呈现三角形，但在移动时其形状变得模糊或不确定。关于高度，据估计该物体在城市上空时高度在500至1000英尺之间，而在科克伦附近的乡村上空时高度在100至200英尺之间。目击者在整个目击过程中均未报告听到任何声音。该物体似乎在1A号高速公路和科克伦附近着陆。

**调查/后续：** 此目击事件已正式报告给卡尔加里市警察局，警方受理了该报告并表示将对此事展开调查。摘要文件中未提供进一步的官方调查结果或气象数据。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mr. G. Loggie, Mrs. Loggie

**Date / Time:** February 12, 1980; between 1155Z and 1200Z

**Location:** Approximately six miles or more south of Lower Newcastle, New Brunswick (observed in the airspace between CFB Chatham and 21 Radar Squadron)

**Sighting:** On February 12, 1980, between 1155Z and 1200Z, Mr. and Mrs. G. Loggie observed a single, unidentified aerial phenomenon while in the vicinity of Lower Newcastle, New Brunswick. The witnesses reported that the sky was cloudy at the time of the event. The object was positioned in the airspace located between CFB Chatham and the 21 Radar Squadron. According to the witnesses, the object was initially observed hovering in the air. During the five-minute duration of the sighting, the object was noted to be heading in an easterly direction. The observation concluded when the object ascended vertically, moving straight up into the cloud layer.

**Object:** The object was described as a single, very bright light. It measured approximately 25 feet or more in length. The witnesses explicitly noted that the object lacked any standard aircraft markings or the typical navigation/position lights associated with conventional aircraft. No sound or other physical characteristics were reported beyond its luminosity, size, and movement.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The sighting was documented as occurring within the operational area between CFB Chatham and 21 Radar Squadron. The official records confirm the date, time, and the specific geographic positioning of the sighting relative to these military installations. No further investigative actions, such as radar correlation or physical evidence collection, were noted in the provided documentation.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** G. 洛吉先生 (Mr. G. Loggie)、洛吉夫人 (Mrs. Loggie)

**日期 / 时间：** 1980年2月12日；1155Z 至 1200Z 之间

**地点：** 新不伦瑞克省下纽卡斯尔 (Lower Newcastle) 以南约六英里或更远处（观测位置位于查塔姆加拿大武装部队基地 (CFB Chatham) 与第21雷达中队之间的空域）

**目击经过：** 1980年2月12日 1155Z 至 1200Z 之间，G. 洛吉夫妇在新不伦瑞克省下纽卡斯尔附近观测到一个单一的不明空中现象。据目击者称，事发时天空多云。该物体位于查塔姆加拿大武装部队基地与第21雷达中队之间的空域。据目击者描述，该物体最初悬停在空中。在五分钟的目击过程中，该物体被观察到正向东飞行。当物体垂直上升并直接进入云层后，观测结束。

**物体描述：** 该物体被描述为一个单一的、非常明亮的光点。其长度约为25英尺或以上。目击者明确指出，该物体没有任何标准飞行器的标识，也没有常规飞行器所具备的典型导航灯或位置灯。除其亮度、尺寸和移动方式外，未报告有任何声音或其他物理特征。

**调查/后续：** 该目击事件被记录为发生在查塔姆加拿大武装部队基地与第21雷达中队之间的作业区域内。官方记录证实了该目击事件的日期、时间和相对于这些军事设施的具体地理位置。所提供的文档中未记录进一步的调查行动，如雷达关联分析或物理证据收集。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** M. Jean Paul Deveau, two local school teachers, a coastguard radio operator, and M. Jean Paul Desaulniers.

**Date / Time:** February 12, 1980 (Note: Page 190 contains a conflicting date of February 13, 1968; however, the case file is indexed under 1980-02-12). The final observation occurred at 2230Z.

**Location:** Magdalen Islands, Quebec; specifically near the Academy/high school in the Grindstone area, near a transmitter site.

**Sighting:** This event involved a series of sightings occurring over two nights, culminating in a fourth observation. M. Jean Paul Deveau, the primary witness, reported observing a strange object northwest of the Academy over the Grindstone area. He shared his observations with two local school teachers, who also witnessed the phenomenon. During the final observation at 2230Z, under clear skies, the object was seen glowing red and changing colors. The witnesses noted that the object’s "volume" (intensity or perceived size) appeared to increase and decrease during the sighting. At this time, the object displayed two distinct antennas—one red and one green—along with a separate green ball. 

Simultaneously, a coastguard radio operator stationed at Grindstone provided a differing account. The operator reported seeing a white ball moving very slowly in a northward direction. This report was officially filed through M. Jean Paul Desaulniers at the Grindstone Coast Guard radio station.

**Object:** The descriptions provided by the witnesses vary, suggesting either a complex object or multiple phenomena. M. Deveau described the object as saucer-shaped, positioned at an altitude of approximately 10,000 feet, and capable of glowing red and violet. He further noted the presence of two antennas (one red, one green) and a green ball. Conversely, the coastguard radio operator described the object as a white ball, estimated to be the size of a 5-gallon drum, moving at a very slow speed. The object was noted for its changing colors and fluctuating intensity/volume.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The sightings were reported to the Grindstone Coast Guard radio station via M. Jean Paul Desaulniers. M. Jean Paul Deveau documented his observations extensively, creating several sketches/designs of the object on paper to illustrate its appearance and the configuration of the antennas. The event was noted as the fourth time the object had been sighted in the area, specifically appearing above a high school near a transmitter site. No further meteorological or official military investigation notes were provided in the summary.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 让·保罗·德沃（M. Jean Paul Deveau）、两名当地学校教师、一名海岸警卫队无线电操作员，以及让·保罗·德索尼耶（M. Jean Paul Desaulniers）。

**日期 / 时间：** 1980年2月12日（注：第190页记载的日期为1968年2月13日，存在冲突；但该档案索引日期为1980年2月12日）。最后一次观测发生在协调世界时（Z）22:30。

**地点：** 魁北克省马格达伦群岛；具体位于格林德斯通（Grindstone）地区的学院/高中附近，靠近一个发射台。

**目击经过：** 该事件涉及连续两个夜晚发生的一系列目击事件，并最终出现了第四次观测。主要目击者让·保罗·德沃报告称，在格林德斯通地区学院的西北方观察到一个奇怪的物体。他将自己的观察结果告知了两名当地学校教师，他们也目睹了这一现象。在协调世界时22:30的最后一次观测中，天空晴朗，该物体呈现出红色并不断变换颜色。目击者注意到，该物体的“体积”（强度或感知大小）在目击过程中似乎在不断增大和缩小。此时，该物体展示出两根独特的天线——一根红色，一根绿色——以及一个独立的绿色球体。

与此同时，驻扎在格林德斯通的一名海岸警卫队无线电操作员提供了不同的说法。该操作员报告称看到一个白色的球体正以非常缓慢的速度向北移动。此报告已通过格林德斯通海岸警卫队无线电站的让·保罗·德索尼耶正式归档。

**物体描述：** 目击者提供的描述各不相同，这表明该物体可能结构复杂，或者存在多种现象。德沃先生将该物体描述为碟状，位于约10,000英尺的高空，能够发出红色和紫色的光。他进一步指出该物体有两根天线（一红一绿）和一个绿色球体。相反，海岸警卫队无线电操作员将其描述为一个白色的球体，估计大小相当于一个5加仑的桶，移动速度非常缓慢。该物体的特点是颜色不断变化，且强度/体积呈现波动。

**调查/后续：** 目击事件通过让·保罗·德索尼耶报告给了格林德斯通海岸警卫队无线电站。让·保罗·德沃对其观察结果进行了详细记录，并在纸上绘制了多幅草图/设计图，以说明物体的外观及天线的配置。该事件被记录为该物体在当地被目击的第四次，具体出现地点为发射台附近的一所高中上方。摘要中未提供进一步的气象或官方军事调查记录。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mr. Larcel Meumier

**Date / Time:** February 13, 1980 (130830Z)

**Location:** 2012 20th Ave, Laval West, Quebec

**Sighting:** 
On February 13, 1980, at 0830Z, Mr. Larcel Meumier, a resident of 2012 20th Ave in Laval West, Quebec, observed an unidentified aerial phenomenon. Mr. Meumier reported seeing a round light that appeared three times as bright as a star. The object was observed in motion, traveling in a trajectory from the north to the south. A distinct feature noted by the witness was a sparkling trail that followed the object as it moved across the sky.

**Object:** 
The object was described as a round light, characterized by a luminosity approximately three times greater than that of a standard star. It possessed a visible sparkling trail. Regarding its movement, the object traveled steadily from north to south. No sound was reported, and the duration of the sighting was not explicitly specified beyond the recorded time of observation.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** 
The sighting was formally reported to Montreal AMIS, which subsequently relayed the information to 22 NRHQ (North American Aerospace Defense Command Region Headquarters) in North Bay. Official documentation regarding the event includes weather data recorded at the time of the sighting, which noted conditions of 2,000 feet scattered clouds and 12 miles of visibility. The case file contains an official stamp indicating that the object was identified by authorities as a possible meteor.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 拉塞尔·默尼耶先生 (Mr. Larcel Meumier)

**日期 / 时间：** 1980年2月13日 (130830Z)

**地点：** 魁北克省拉瓦尔西区，第20大道2012号

**目击经过：** 
1980年2月13日0830Z，居住在魁北克省拉瓦尔西区第20大道2012号的拉塞尔·默尼耶先生观测到一种不明空中现象。默尼耶先生报告称，他看到一个圆形的亮光，其亮度约为恒星的三倍。该物体处于运动状态，轨迹由北向南。目击者特别指出，该物体在天空中移动时，身后拖着一条明显的闪烁尾迹。

**物体描述：** 
该物体被描述为一个圆形光源，亮度约为普通恒星的三倍。它带有可见的闪烁尾迹。在运动方面，该物体由北向南平稳飞行。据报告未发出任何声音，除记录的观测时间外，未明确说明目击持续时长。

**调查/后续：** 
此次目击事件被正式报告给蒙特利尔AMIS（不明飞行物调查组织），该组织随后将信息转达至位于北湾的第22北美防空司令部区域总部 (22 NRHQ)。关于此次事件的官方档案包括目击时的天气数据，记录显示当时有2000英尺高的疏云，能见度为12英里。案卷中盖有官方印章，表明当局将该物体认定为一颗可能的流星。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mr. Doug Carson, Mrs. Doug Carson

**Date / Time:** February 14, 1980 (Time not specified)

**Location:** Scotch Settlement, Moncton, New Brunswick (near the Moncton Airport, northeast of the city)

**Sighting:** 
Mr. and Mrs. Doug Carson, residents of Scotch Settlement, reported observing an unidentified aerial phenomenon in the vicinity of the Moncton Airport, located northeast of the city. According to the witnesses, the object appeared high in the sky and remained completely stationary throughout the duration of the sighting. The report of this event was initially received by the Moncton Air Traffic Control (ATC) shift supervisor, who documented the account provided by the couple.

**Object:** 
The object was described as a bright white light characterized by a distinct red tinge. It was observed to be high in the sky and maintained a stationary position. No specific details regarding the object's size, sound, or duration were provided in the available documentation.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** 
The sighting was formally reported by the Moncton ATC shift supervisor. Following the initial report, the documentation regarding the Carson sighting was forwarded to the Herzberg Institute of Astrophysics at the National Research Council for further review and analysis.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 道格·卡森先生（Mr. Doug Carson）、道格·卡森夫人（Mrs. Doug Carson）

**日期 / 时间：** 1980年2月14日（具体时间未详）

**地点：** 新不伦瑞克省蒙克顿市苏格兰定居点（Scotch Settlement, Moncton, New Brunswick）（靠近蒙克顿机场，位于城市东北方向）

**目击经过：** 
居住在苏格兰定居点的道格·卡森夫妇报告称，他们在蒙克顿机场附近（位于城市东北方）观察到一种不明空中现象。据目击者描述，该物体出现在高空，并在整个目击过程中保持完全静止。该事件最初由蒙克顿空中交通管制（ATC）的值班主管接收，并记录了这对夫妇提供的陈述。

**物体描述：** 
该物体被描述为一个明亮的白光，带有明显的红色色调。据观察，它位于高空并保持静止状态。现有文档中未提供关于该物体的大小、声音或持续时间的具体细节。

**调查/后续：** 
此次目击事件由蒙克顿空中交通管制值班主管正式上报。在初步报告之后，有关卡森夫妇目击事件的文档被转交至加拿大国家研究委员会下属的赫茨伯格天体物理研究所（Herzberg Institute of Astrophysics），以进行进一步的审查与分析。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Laurent Sivret, Jean Sivret, Ethienne Ward, Simon Sivret, Claudette Sivret, and residents of Shippegan, NB (reported via RCMP Constable St. Pierre).

**Date / Time:** February 14, 1980, at 23:30 hours; and February 15, 1980, at 0350Z and 0500Z.

**Location:** Miscou Centre, West Miscou Island, and Pigeon Hill, New Brunswick.

**Sighting:** 
The event involved multiple reports of an aerial phenomenon over the Miscou/Shippegan area. On February 14, 1980, at 23:30 hours, five witnesses—Laurent Sivret, Jean Sivret, Ethienne Ward, Simon Sivret, and Claudette Sivret—observed an object while inside a house in Miscou Centre. They described the sky as hazy at the time. The object remained stationary above the tree line, approximately 1 to 1.5 miles west of the center of the island. After remaining stationary, the object moved up and down twice before descending and disappearing from view. The duration of this specific sighting was between two and five minutes.

Later, on February 15, 1980, further reports were made to the RCMP. Residents of Shippegan reported seeing a light over West Miscou Island and Pigeon Hill at 0350Z. A subsequent report logged by the RCMP at 0500Z confirmed sightings in the West Miscou Island area.

**Object:** 
The object was described by the Sivret group as perfectly round and approximately 3 feet in diameter. It exhibited a glowing quality, cycling through three distinct colors—bright red, orange, and green—before returning to red. Other reports from the Shippegan area described the object simply as a "big red light." The movement was characterized as floating or moving up and down, with witnesses estimating the vertical travel at approximately 200 feet. No sound was reported.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** 
The initial report was received by RCMP Constable St. Pierre in Moncton. The incident was formally documented and relayed through several channels, including C-5 DMCC, 22 RCC, SPADATS NCOC, and the Herzberg Institute of Astrophysics. An official inquiry was conducted with the St. Margarets Radar Base (Air Force) to determine if the object had been tracked; however, the radar check yielded negative results.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 洛朗·西弗雷 (Laurent Sivret)、让·西弗雷 (Jean Sivret)、艾蒂安·沃德 (Ethienne Ward)、西蒙·西弗雷 (Simon Sivret)、克洛黛特·西弗雷 (Claudette Sivret)，以及新不伦瑞克省希普根 (Shippegan) 的居民（通过加拿大皇家骑警圣皮埃尔警官报告）。

**日期 / 时间：** 1980年2月14日 23:30；以及1980年2月15日 03:50Z 和 0500Z。

**地点：** 新不伦瑞克省米斯库中心 (Miscou Centre)、西米斯库岛 (West Miscou Island) 及皮金山 (Pigeon Hill)。

**目击经过：**
该事件涉及多起关于米斯库/希普根地区上空空中现象的报告。1980年2月14日23:30，五名目击者——洛朗·西弗雷、让·西弗雷、艾蒂安·沃德、西蒙·西弗雷和克洛黛特·西弗雷——在米斯库中心的一所屋内观察到了一个物体。他们描述当时天空有雾。该物体悬停在岛中心以西约1至1.5英里处的树线之上，保持静止。在静止一段时间后，该物体上下移动了两次，随后下降并消失在视野中。此次目击持续时间约为两到五分钟。

随后，在1980年2月15日，加拿大皇家骑警 (RCMP) 接到了更多报告。希普根的居民报告称，在0350Z时看到西米斯库岛和皮金山上空出现一道光。RCMP在0500Z记录的后续报告证实了西米斯库岛地区的目击事件。

**物体描述：**
西弗雷一行人将该物体描述为一个完美的圆形，直径约3英尺。它呈现出发光状态，在三种不同的颜色——亮红色、橙色和绿色——之间循环变换，最后回到红色。来自希普根地区的其他报告则简单地将其描述为“一个巨大的红光”。其运动特征为漂浮或上下移动，目击者估计其垂直移动距离约为200英尺。未报告有任何声音。

**调查/后续：**
最初的报告由蒙克顿的加拿大皇家骑警圣皮埃尔 (St. Pierre) 警官接收。该事件被正式记录并通过多个渠道进行传达，包括C-5 DMCC、22 RCC、SPADATS NCOC以及赫茨伯格天体物理研究所 (Herzberg Institute of Astrophysics)。官方曾向圣玛格丽特雷达基地（空军）进行查询，以确定该物体是否被追踪到；然而，雷达检查结果为阴性。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mr. Gilles Brien (Hydro Quebec, Poste Montagnais), Mr. Gilbert Duguay, and Mr. Roch Champagne.

**Date / Time:** February 17, 1980, at 0110Z.

**Location:** Poste Montagnais, Quebec.

**Sighting:** On February 17, 1980, at 0110Z, three witnesses—Gilles Brien, Gilbert Duguay, and Roch Champagne, all employees of Hydro Quebec stationed at Poste Montagnais—observed an unidentified aerial phenomenon. The sighting occurred under cloudy weather conditions. The witnesses collectively observed the object for a total duration of 6 minutes. The object was positioned just above the horizon at a distance estimated to be less than one mile from their location. All three witnesses reported that the object moved at a very slow speed throughout the duration of the observation.

**Object:** The object was described as having a distinct reddish color. It maintained a low altitude just above the horizon and exhibited a very slow, steady movement. No specific shape or sound characteristics were documented in the available reports beyond the color and movement profile.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The sighting was formally documented and reported through official military and government channels. The report was transmitted from CFS Moisie to the National Defence Command Centre (NDCO) in Ottawa and subsequently to the National Research Council (NRC) for review. No further investigative details, sketches, or additional follow-up actions were recorded in the provided case file documentation.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 吉尔·布里恩先生（Gilles Brien，魁北克水电公司，蒙塔涅变电站）、吉尔伯特·杜盖先生（Gilbert Duguay）以及罗奇·香槟先生（Roch Champagne）。

**日期 / 时间：** 1980年2月17日，01:10Z（协调世界时）。

**地点：** 魁北克省，蒙塔涅变电站（Poste Montagnais）。

**目击经过：** 1980年2月17日01:10Z，三名目击者——吉尔·布里恩、吉尔伯特·杜盖和罗奇·香槟（均为驻扎在蒙塔涅变电站的魁北克水电公司员工）观察到一种不明空中现象。目击发生时天气多云。三名目击者共同观察该物体的时间总计为6分钟。该物体位于地平线正上方，距离他们的位置估计不到一英里。三名目击者均报告称，在整个观察过程中，该物体以非常缓慢的速度移动。

**物体描述：** 该物体被描述为具有明显的红色。它保持在地平线以上的低空，并呈现出非常缓慢、平稳的移动状态。在现有的报告记录中，除颜色和移动特征外，未记载该物体的具体形状或声音特征。

**调查/后续：** 该目击事件已通过官方军事和政府渠道正式记录并上报。报告由莫伊西加拿大武装部队基地（CFS Moisie）传达至渥太华的国家国防指挥中心（NDCO），随后转交至加拿大国家研究委员会（NRC）进行审查。在提供的档案文件中，未记录进一步的调查细节、草图或其他后续行动。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Jean-Claude St-Opel (also referred to as M. Riopel / Jean-Claude Riopel), Cpl. Martel, Cpl. Pilon Andre, Sgt. Leclerc Alain, Sgt. Perron Andre.

**Date / Time:** February 20, 1980 (primary sighting); additional reports reference dates of February 15, 1967, February 20, 1971, and March 4, 1965.

**Location:** Lac St-Charles, Quebec; Route 175, Route 169, and Route 170; vicinity of Mont-Apica.

**Sighting:** The case file documents a recurring phenomenon involving a spherical object observed by a witness identified variously as Jean-Claude St-Opel, M. Riopel, or Jean-Claude Riopel. While the dates provided in the file are inconsistent (ranging from 1965 to 1980), the core narrative describes the witness driving a truck north on various routes (175, 169, 170). The witness consistently reported a sphere emerging from a field or appearing ahead of his vehicle, maintaining a distance of approximately 7 to 15 feet in front of the truck. The object would travel at speeds ranging from 10 to 80 mph before accelerating toward the center of the road and stopping above high-voltage power lines. 

Upon stopping, the object would hover, often oscillating or exhibiting a "propeller-like" movement. The witness frequently exited his vehicle to observe the object from a depression in the road or terrain. In one account, the object emitted a humming sound; in another, it emitted sparks upon hovering near the power lines. The duration of the primary sighting was noted as 18 minutes. Separately, RCMP officers Cpl. Pilon Andre, Sgt. Leclerc Alain, and Sgt. Perron Andre reported observing white circular objects moving in various directions (north to south, top to bottom, left to right) near the mountains northwest of the Mont-Apica station.

**Object:** The object is consistently described as a sphere, though its size and color vary across reports: 3 feet, 5 feet, 6 feet, and 10 feet in diameter. Color descriptions include yellow, dull yellow, jade, and dark-colored. The object consistently lacked internal light or brilliance, possessing a sharp, clear, or dark contour. Movement was described as hovering, oscillating, or exhibiting a propeller-like motion, with a distinct humming sound noted in one instance.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The investigation was conducted primarily by Cpl. Martel of the RCMP, who interviewed the witness on multiple occasions. Martel consistently characterized the witness as a sincere, mature, sober, and composed individual who initially withheld reports due to a fear of public ridicule. The witness expressed a willingness to cooperate with military authorities and even offered to undergo a lie detector test to prove his sincerity. The file notes that other individuals had reported similar sightings near the Mont-Apica station, though many of these were never officially recorded. The RCMP documented the witness's desire for an official investigation of the site to verify the intensity of the event.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 让-克洛德·圣奥佩尔（Jean-Claude St-Opel，亦被称为里奥佩尔先生 / 让-克洛德·里奥佩尔 Jean-Claude Riopel）、马特尔下士（Cpl. Martel）、安德烈·皮隆下士（Cpl. Pilon Andre）、阿兰·勒克莱尔中士（Sgt. Leclerc Alain）、安德烈·佩隆中士（Sgt. Perron Andre）。

**日期 / 时间：** 1980年2月20日（主要目击事件）；其他报告提及的日期包括1967年2月15日、1971年2月20日以及1965年3月4日。

**地点：** 魁北克省圣查尔斯湖（Lac St-Charles）；175号公路、169号公路及170号公路；蒙特阿皮卡（Mont-Apica）附近。

**目击经过：** 该档案记录了一种反复出现的现象，涉及一个被目击者（身份在让-克洛德·圣奥佩尔、里奥佩尔先生或让-克洛德·里奥佩尔之间变动）观察到的球状物体。尽管档案中提供的日期不尽一致（跨度从1965年至1980年），但核心叙述描述了该目击者驾驶卡车在多条公路（175、169、170号）上向北行驶的过程。目击者始终报告称，一个球体从田野中浮现或出现在其车辆前方，并与卡车保持约7至15英尺的距离。该物体以每小时10至80英里的速度行驶，随后加速驶向道路中央，并悬停在高压电线上方。

物体停下后会进行悬停，通常伴有摆动或呈现出“螺旋桨式”的运动。目击者经常下车，从道路或地形的低洼处观察该物体。在其中一次描述中，物体发出了嗡嗡声；在另一次描述中，它在靠近高压电线悬停时迸发出火花。主要目击事件的持续时间记录为18分钟。此外，加拿大皇家骑警（RCMP）的安德烈·皮隆下士、阿兰·勒克莱尔中士和安德烈·佩隆中士也报告称，在蒙特阿皮卡站西北部的山区附近，观察到了白色圆形物体向不同方向（南北方向、上下方向、左右方向）移动。

**物体描述：** 该物体始终被描述为球体，尽管在不同报告中其尺寸和颜色有所差异：直径分别为3英尺、5英尺、6英尺和10英尺。颜色描述包括黄色、暗黄色、玉色和深色。该物体始终没有内部光源或光泽，具有清晰、明确或深色的轮廓。其运动方式被描述为悬停、摆动或呈现螺旋桨式的动作，其中一次目击中还记录到了明显的嗡嗡声。

**调查/后续：** 调查主要由加拿大皇家骑警的马特尔下士负责，他曾多次采访该目击者。马特尔始终将目击者描述为一位真诚、成熟、清醒且沉着的人，他起初因担心遭受公众嘲笑而隐瞒了报告。目击者表示愿意与军事当局合作，甚至主动提出接受测谎仪测试以证明其诚意。档案指出，其他人也曾在蒙特阿皮卡站附近报告过类似的目击事件，但其中许多并未被正式记录。加拿大皇家骑警记录了目击者的诉求，即希望对该地点进行官方调查，以核实事件的强度。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mark Topliff, David Martin

**Date / Time:** March 8, 1980, at approximately 21:15 PST

**Location:** Base of Red Mountain Ski Hill, Rossland, BC (elevation approximately 4,000 feet)

**Sighting:**
On the evening of March 8, 1980, at 21:15 PST, Mark Topliff—a 22-year-old member of the local ski patrol—and David Martin were at the base of the Red Mountain Ski Hill. While looking east into a clear sky, both witnesses observed an anomalous aerial object. The object traveled in a northerly direction at an angle of approximately 30 to 40 degrees, following a downward trajectory. The entire sighting lasted for approximately 3 to 4 seconds.

As the object moved behind a small mountain ridge—estimated to be between a half-mile and a mile away from the witnesses' location—it appeared to emit a shower of red sparks. Topliff, who is noted as being highly knowledgeable of the local terrain, observed that the object was close enough to the mountainside that it illuminated a portion of the mountain as it passed. Topliff expressed the belief that the object may have landed on the mountain. Following the disappearance of the object behind the ridge, the glowing tail vanished. No sounds were heard by either witness during the event.

**Object:**
The object was described as a large, bright red glowing entity. It featured a short, glowing red tail. Its movement was characterized as "fairly slow" as it descended at a 30-40 degree angle. The object did not produce any audible sound. The visual display concluded with a shower of red sparks before the object disappeared behind the mountain terrain.

**Investigation / Follow-up:**
The incident was reported via Nelson Telecom to the Rossland RCMP detachment. Following the sighting, Mark Topliff conducted a physical search of the area on foot to investigate the possibility that the object had landed. Despite his familiarity with the terrain, he was unable to locate any physical traces or evidence of the object. Official documentation from the National Research Council and the RCMP file includes a stamp identifying the event as a "possible meteor."
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 马克·托普利夫 (Mark Topliff)、大卫·马丁 (David Martin)

**日期 / 时间：** 1980年3月8日，太平洋标准时间约21:15

**地点：** 不列颠哥伦比亚省罗斯兰市，红山滑雪场底部（海拔约4000英尺）

**目击经过：**
1980年3月8日晚21:15（太平洋标准时间），22岁的当地滑雪巡逻队员马克·托普利夫与大卫·马丁身处红山滑雪场底部。当两人向东望向晴朗的夜空时，共同观测到一个异常的空中物体。该物体正以约30至40度的角度向北飞行，轨迹呈下降趋势。整个目击过程持续了约3至4秒。

当物体移动到一座小山脊后方时（据估计距离目击者约半英里至一英里），它似乎喷射出了一阵红色火花。对当地地形非常熟悉的托普利夫观察到，该物体距离山坡非常近，以至于在经过时照亮了部分山体。托普利夫认为该物体可能已经在山上坠落。在物体消失于山脊后方后，其发光的尾迹也随之消失。整个过程中，两位目击者均未听到任何声音。

**物体描述：**
该物体被描述为一个巨大且发出明亮红光的实体，带有一条短而发光的红色尾迹。其移动速度被形容为“相当缓慢”，并以30至40度的角度下降。该物体未发出任何声响。目击过程以一阵红色火花的喷射结束，随后物体消失在山峦之后。

**调查/后续：**
该事件通过尼尔森电信公司 (Nelson Telecom) 上报给了罗斯兰皇家骑警 (RCMP) 分局。目击事件发生后，马克·托普利夫徒步对该区域进行了实地搜寻，以调查物体是否坠落的可能性。尽管他对当地地形非常熟悉，但仍未能找到任何物理痕迹或证据。加拿大国家研究委员会 (National Research Council) 的官方文件及皇家骑警的档案中，盖有将此事件标记为“可能是流星”的印章。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Joe Mihalicz and his family.

**Date / Time:** March 12, 1980, at 2100Z.

**Location:** 8 miles west of Endeavour, Saskatchewan.

**Sighting:** On the evening of March 12, 1980, at 2100Z, Joe Mihalicz and his family observed an unidentified aerial phenomenon while located 8 miles west of Endeavour, Saskatchewan. The weather conditions at the time of the sighting were reported as clear. The family observed the object for a total duration of one and one-half hours. According to the accounts provided by the Mihalicz family, the object remained generally stationary in its position, though it exhibited distinct vertical movement, appearing to move up and down. During these maneuvers, the object was observed dipping below the horizon at various intervals before returning to its position.

**Object:** The object was described as a single, stationary entity characterized by a sequence of flashing lights. These lights displayed a combination of red, blue, and white colors. The primary movement of the object consisted of vertical oscillations, specifically moving up and down and periodically dipping below the horizon line. The total duration of the observation was one and one-half hours.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The documentation provided consists of two pages (238 and 239) detailing the same event. Both pages confirm the date, time, location, and the specific observations made by Joe Mihalicz and his family. No further investigative notes, RCMP reports, or sketches were included in the provided file segments; the records indicate that no additional information or aftermath details were reported beyond the initial sighting description.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 乔·米哈利奇（Joe Mihalicz）及其家人。

**日期 / 时间：** 1980年3月12日，2100Z（协调世界时）。

**地点：** 萨斯喀彻温省恩德弗（Endeavour）以西8英里处。

**目击经过：** 1980年3月12日晚2100Z，乔·米哈利奇及其家人在萨斯喀彻温省恩德弗以西8英里处观察到一种不明空中现象。据报告，目击时的天气状况晴朗。该家庭对该物体进行了总计一个半小时的观察。据米哈利奇一家描述，该物体在位置上基本保持静止，但表现出明显的垂直运动，看起来在上下移动。在这些移动过程中，该物体被观察到多次沉入地平线以下，随后又回到原位。

**物体描述：** 该物体被描述为一个单一的、静止的实体，其特征是一连串闪烁的灯光。这些灯光呈现出红色、蓝色和白色的组合。该物体的主要运动方式为垂直振荡，即上下移动，并周期性地沉入地平线以下。观察总时长为一个半小时。

**调查/后续：** 所提供的文件由两页（第238页和第239页）组成，详细记录了同一事件。两页文件均确认了日期、时间、地点以及乔·米哈利奇及其家人所做的具体观察。所提供的文件片段中未包含进一步的调查记录、加拿大皇家骑警（RCMP）报告或草图；记录显示，除了最初的目击描述外，没有报告任何额外信息或后续详情。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Robert Baillard (also referred to as Mr. Robert Baillard of Pincourt, Quebec).

**Date / Time:** The case file contains conflicting dates for the same described event: March 13, 1980, and March 15, 1968. The sighting lasted for a total duration of one and a half hours.

**Location:** Lac des Montagnes, Quebec (also referred to as the Lake of Two Mountains, Quebec).

**Sighting:** The witness, Robert Baillard, observed an unidentified object positioned over the lake at an estimated altitude of 4,000 feet. The object remained stationary for approximately 20 minutes. Following this initial period of stillness, the object began moving in circles before returning to a stationary position. Subsequently, it performed rapid lateral movements, traveling from left to right, before abruptly reversing its direction. The witness described the object’s movement during these maneuvers as "very fast." The entire observation lasted for a total duration of one and a half hours.

**Object:** The object was described as being "star and triangular" in shape, with a physical size comparable to that of a large aircraft. It appeared shiny white in color, accented by red lights, and was noted to be brighter than a star. Throughout the duration of the sighting, the object emitted no sound.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The report was processed by the Aircom Operations Centre and subsequently routed to the National Research Council in Ottawa for further review. The case file is currently classified as "unclassified."
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_15_-_Pages_42.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 罗伯特·巴亚尔（Robert Baillard，也被称为魁北克省平库尔的罗伯特·巴亚尔先生）。

**日期 / 时间：** 案件档案中对于同一事件的描述存在日期冲突：分别是1980年3月13日和1968年3月15日。目击过程总持续时间为一个半小时。

**地点：** 魁北克省蒙塔涅湖（Lac des Montagnes，也被称为魁北克省双山湖）。

**目击经过：** 目击者罗伯特·巴亚尔观察到一个不明物体悬停在湖面上空，估计高度为4,000英尺。该物体保持静止状态约20分钟。在最初的静止期过后，物体开始盘旋移动，随后又恢复到静止状态。紧接着，它进行了快速的横向移动，从左向右穿梭，随后突然反向飞行。目击者形容该物体在这些机动过程中的移动“非常迅速”。整个观察过程总计持续了一个半小时。

**物体描述：** 该物体被描述为“星形和三角形”，其实际尺寸与大型飞机相当。它呈现出闪亮的白色，并带有红色灯光点缀，亮度比恒星更亮。在整个目击过程中，该物体未发出任何声音。

**调查/后续：** 该报告由加拿大空军作战中心（Aircom Operations Centre）处理，随后被转送至渥太华的国家研究委员会（National Research Council）进行进一步审查。目前该案件档案被归类为“未分类”。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mr. Maurice Boutet, residing at 4901 Michelle Drive, Hanmer, Ontario.

**Sighting:** On April 22, 1972, at 0215Z, the witness observed an object due east of the village of Hanmer. The weather conditions included thin broken clouds with an estimated ceiling of 25,000 feet overcast and 15 miles visibility.

**Object:** The object appeared to look like an aircraft on fire. It was difficult to look at due to its brightness. While the observer was watching, a part of the object appeared to drop off, also in flames. The duration of the sighting was approximately 2 minutes.

**Aftermath:** Sudbury Airport was contacted to determine if any aircraft were airborne in the area. They reported one aircraft was airborne, but its position was approximately 30 miles north of the city of Sudbury. The observer stated he was about to get his wife to look at the object when it disappeared.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 居住在安大略省汉默（Hanmer）米歇尔大道（Michelle Drive）4901号的莫里斯·布泰（Maurice Boutet）先生。

**目击：** 1972年4月22日0215Z，目击者在汉默村以东观察到一个物体。当时天气状况为薄云，估计云底高度为25,000英尺，能见度15英里。

**物体：** 该物体看起来像一架着火的飞机。由于其亮度极高，难以直视。在观察过程中，物体的一部分似乎脱落，同样带有火焰。目击持续时间约为2分钟。

**后续：** 萨德伯里（Sudbury）机场被联系以核实当时是否有飞机在空中。机场报告称有一架飞机在空中，但其位置在萨德伯里市以北约30英里处。目击者称，他正准备叫妻子一起来看时，物体就消失了。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Two members of the Prince George Rural Detachment of the RCMP.

**Sighting:** On May 4, 1972, at 4:30 AM, witnesses observed a bright white light heading south over the Prince George Airport. The sighting lasted for approximately 20 minutes under clear skies.

**Object:** The object was circular in shape and appeared to be about three times the size of the stars, but much brighter. It slowed down, performed a rapid vertical rise, and decreased in size as it ascended. It then moved eastward in a jerky, zig-zag path, stopped to oscillate in one spot, and subsequently moved in a zig-zag path toward the northwest.

**Aftermath:** No sound was heard, and there were no bursts, tails, or shadows noted on the light. The report was filed by the Prince George Sub Division of the RCMP to the NRC Meteor Centre.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 两名加拿大皇家骑警（RCMP）乔治王子城农村分局的成员。

**目击：** 1972年5月4日凌晨4点30分，目击者观察到一束明亮的白光向南飞越乔治王子城机场。在晴朗的天空下，目击持续了约20分钟。

**物体：** 该物体呈圆形，看起来大约是星星大小的三倍，但亮度要高得多。它减速后进行了快速垂直上升，并在上升过程中尺寸减小。随后，它以颠簸的“之”字形路径向东移动，停下来在一个点上摆动，接着又以“之”字形路径向西北方向移动。

**后续：** 现场未听到任何声音，也没有观察到光束、尾迹或阴影。该报告由加拿大皇家骑警乔治王子城分区提交给加拿大国家研究委员会（NRC）流星中心。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mrs. Nelma Graham, Mr. Gordon Graham

**Date / Time:** May 1, 1972, at 12:15 AM ADST; May 2, 1972, at 12:40 AM ADST

**Location:** Maple Ridge, New Brunswick

**Sighting:** 
On May 1, 1972, at approximately 12:15 AM ADST, Mrs. Nelma Graham observed an unidentified object from her home. She maintained observation of the object for approximately 20 minutes before it disappeared over the horizon. Her husband, Mr. Gordon Graham, also observed the object for a duration of approximately 10 minutes during this initial sighting. 

A second, identical sighting occurred at the same location the following night, May 2, 1972. This event began at 12:40 AM ADST and lasted until approximately 1:00 AM ADST. During both sightings, the sky was clear with the moon visible in the eastern sky. The witnesses reported that the object was positioned in the north-west sky and appeared to be flying at a very high altitude.

**Object:** 
The object was described as being quite large and distinctively cross-shaped. It displayed a prominent red color, specifically noted as a blinking red light. Regarding its movement, accounts vary slightly: one report states the object did not move vertically but moved continuously, while another report indicates it moved vertically and continuously. No sound was heard by the witnesses during the observation.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** 
The Fredericton Detachment of the RCMP was alerted to the sightings via a report in the local newspaper, *The Daily Gleaner*. Following their review, the RCMP forwarded a radio-gram regarding the incident to the National Research Council (NRC) Meteor Centre on May 4, 1972. The investigating officers noted that the witnesses appeared to be upstanding citizens. No further official action was taken by the RCMP regarding the matter.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 内尔玛·格雷厄姆夫人 (Mrs. Nelma Graham)、戈登·格雷厄姆先生 (Mr. Gordon Graham)

**日期 / 时间：** 1972年5月1日凌晨12:15（大西洋夏令时间）；1972年5月2日凌晨12:40（大西洋夏令时间）

**地点：** 新不伦瑞克省，枫树岭 (Maple Ridge, New Brunswick)

**目击经过：**
1972年5月1日凌晨12:15左右，内尔玛·格雷厄姆夫人在家中观察到了一个不明飞行物。她对该物体进行了约20分钟的持续观察，随后物体消失在地平线外。她的丈夫戈登·格雷厄姆先生在这次初步目击中也观察了该物体约10分钟。

次日（1972年5月2日）同一地点再次发生了完全相同的目击事件。该事件始于凌晨12:40，持续至凌晨1:00左右。两次目击期间，天空晴朗，月亮可见于东部天空。据目击者称，该物体位于西北方天空，且飞行高度极高。

**物体描述：**
该物体被描述为体型相当巨大，且呈现出独特的十字形状。它显示出醒目的红色，具体表现为闪烁的红光。关于其运动方式，描述略有出入：一份报告称该物体没有垂直移动，而是持续平移；另一份报告则指出它进行了持续的垂直移动。目击者在观察过程中未听到任何声音。

**调查/后续：**
加拿大皇家骑警 (RCMP) 弗雷德里克顿分局通过当地报纸《每日拾穗者》(The Daily Gleaner) 的报道获悉了这些目击事件。在进行审查后，加拿大皇家骑警于1972年5月4日向国家研究委员会 (NRC) 流星中心发送了一份关于此事件的无线电报。调查警官指出，目击者看起来是正直的公民。加拿大皇家骑警未就此事采取进一步的官方行动。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mrs. F. Fandrey.

**Sighting:** On June 5, 1972, at 12:05 AM CST, the witness observed an object in the sky under clear conditions. The object was reported to have been seen every night since the last week of April, between 11:55 PM and 12:30 AM.

**Object:** The object is described as oblong in shape and emitting a glowing red light. It appears to be located in the area of Good Spirit Lake, northwest of Ebenezer, Saskatchewan, and moves up and down in the sky.

**Aftermath:** The Yorkton Municipal Detachment of the RCMP filed this report to the NRC Meteor Centre, noting that a full report was to follow.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** F. Fandrey 夫人。

**目击：** 1972 年 6 月 5 日凌晨 12:05（中部标准时间），目击者在晴朗的天空下观察到一个物体。据报告，自 4 月最后一周以来，该物体每晚在晚上 11:55 至凌晨 12:30 之间都会出现。

**物体：** 该物体被描述为长方形，发出红色的光。它似乎位于萨斯喀彻温省 Ebenezer 西北部的 Good Spirit 湖区域，并在天空中上下移动。

**后续：** 加拿大皇家骑警 (RCMP) Yorkton 市分局向加拿大国家研究委员会 (NRC) 流星中心提交了此报告，并注明后续将提供完整报告。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Mr. Jas. Robb。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mr. S. Seguin, his wife, and potentially other individuals.

**Sighting:** The event occurred on May 8, 1972, between 0320Z and 0400Z in clear sky conditions. The observer was located en route to his home and at his home in Point Gatineau, P.Q.

**Object:** The object moved down towards the ground and then back up. Its color changed from white to red. It appeared three times larger than a star, and its shape was obscured by its brightness. It produced no sound and left no trail.

**Aftermath:** The observation lasted for 40 minutes. Approximately 25 feet of movie film was captured of the object using a Bell and Howell Super 8 camera, with footage taken from different angles.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** S. 塞甘（S. Seguin）先生、其妻子，以及其他可能的目击者。

**日期：** 1972年5月8日，格林威治标准时间（Z）03:20至04:00之间，当时天空晴朗。

**地点：** 目击者在前往魁北克省加蒂诺角（Point Gatineau, P.Q.）的途中及其家中。

**目击经过：** 该物体向地面移动，随后又升回空中。其颜色由白色变为红色。它看起来比恒星大三倍，由于亮度过高，其形状难以辨认。该物体在移动过程中未发出任何声音，也未留下任何尾迹。

**调查/后续：** 观测过程持续了40分钟。目击者使用一台贝尔-豪威尔（Bell and Howell）Super 8摄像机拍摄了约25英尺长的胶片，记录了该物体在不同角度下的影像。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** A man from Willow Point (unnamed), Bob House (Upper Islander photographer).

**Date / Time:** May 1972 (Monday sighting, Tuesday follow-up).

**Location:** Quadra Island, British Columbia.

**Sighting:** A man from Willow Point observed a circular, discus-shaped object hovering over Quadra Island on a Monday. The witness reported that the object remained in the sky for approximately 15 minutes. According to the witness, the object moved “around like a top,” hovering almost motionless before it began to wobble and tilt to one side. It then shuddered and climbed almost vertically for approximately 1,000 feet. After leveling off, the object departed on a zig-zag course toward the north at a “fantastic speed,” at which point the witness lost sight of it. The witness explicitly rejected the possibility that the object was a conventional aircraft, such as a plane or helicopter.

**Object:** The object was described as a circular, discus-shaped craft with no wings, no rotors, and no visible markings. Its surface had a dull sheen, described as looking “like dirty chrome.” The object featured lights around its rim that flashed on and off in a seemingly random sequence. Its movement was characterized by spinning, wobbling, tilting, shuddering, and high-speed zig-zagging.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The witness took seven photographs of the object during the sighting. He requested that *The Upper Islander* newspaper develop the film and forward the images to the military for identification. *Upper Islander* photographer Bob House stated on the following Tuesday that only one of the seven photographs was printable. Specialists at CFB Comox were tasked with attempting to identify the object captured in the photograph.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 一名来自威洛角（Willow Point）的男子（未透露姓名），鲍勃·豪斯（Bob House，上岛报社摄影师）。

**日期 / 时间：** 1972年5月（周一目击，周二后续跟进）。

**地点：** 不列颠哥伦比亚省，夸德拉岛（Quadra Island）。

**目击经过：** 一名来自威洛角的男子于周一观察到一个圆形的圆盘状物体悬停在夸德拉岛上空。据目击者报告，该物体在空中停留了约15分钟。据其描述，该物体“像陀螺一样旋转”，在几乎静止悬停后开始晃动并向一侧倾斜。随后，它发生震颤并几乎垂直向上爬升了约1000英尺。在平稳飞行后，该物体以“惊人的速度”呈之字形向北飞去，随后目击者失去了对它的视线。目击者明确排除了该物体是飞机或直升机等常规飞行器的可能性。

**物体描述：** 该物体被描述为一种圆形的圆盘状飞行器，没有机翼、没有旋翼，也没有可见的标识。其表面呈现出一种暗淡的光泽，被形容为“像脏铬金属”。物体边缘环绕着灯光，以看似随机的顺序闪烁。其运动特征表现为旋转、晃动、倾斜、震颤以及高速的之字形飞行。

**调查/后续：** 目击者在目击过程中拍摄了七张该物体的照片。他要求《上岛报》（*The Upper Islander*）冲洗胶卷，并将照片转交给军方进行鉴定。上岛报社摄影师鲍勃·豪斯于次周二表示，七张照片中只有一张可以冲印出来。科莫克斯加拿大空军基地（CFB Comox）的专家随后负责尝试识别照片中拍摄到的物体。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Orrland Ericson, and RCMP Constables DF Ferrel, WJ Rideout, and LE Ryll.

**Sighting:** On May 22, 1972, at 11:15 PM CST, in clear skies, an object was sighted near 1637 Warren Ave, Weyburn, Saskatchewan. The object was observed from directly below, appearing round and approximately 1500 feet high. It appeared about half the size of the moon, decreasing in size as the distance increased. The brightness varied from dull orange to bright orange, resembling fire. It left no trail and made no noise.

**Object:** The object was easily seen for approximately 18 miles westward from Weyburn before it disappeared. It appeared to disappear for 30-second intervals. Sometimes its speed seemed to increase.

**Aftermath:** The object was followed by a police car for approximately [unclear] NNW from Weyburn until it could no longer be seen. Mr. John Hodges of the Regina, Saskatchewan National Research Council committee was advised at approximately 12:30 AM on May 23. No further information was received.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Orrland Ericson，以及加拿大皇家骑警警员 DF Ferrel、WJ Rideout 和 LE Ryll。

**目击：** 1972年5月22日晚上11:15（中部标准时间），在天空晴朗的情况下，萨斯喀彻温省韦伯恩市 Warren 大道1637号附近发现了一个物体。该物体从正下方被观测到，呈圆形，高度约为1500英尺。它看起来大约有月亮的一半大小，随着距离增加而变小。亮度在暗橙色到亮橙色之间变化，类似于火光。它没有留下尾迹，也没有发出声音。

**物体：** 该物体在从韦伯恩向西约18英里的范围内很容易被看到，随后消失。它似乎每隔约30秒消失一次。有时它的速度似乎会增加。

**后续：** 一辆警车跟随该物体从韦伯恩向北偏西北方向行驶了约[不清晰]距离，直到无法再看到它。萨斯喀彻温省里贾纳国家研究委员会的 John Hodges 先生于5月23日凌晨12:30左右收到通知。此后未收到进一步信息。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:

**Sighting:** On May 25, 1972, at 0900Z, the witness was at a house located on a hill at 10 Mile Point, Victoria. The weather was clear with 10 miles visibility and calm winds.

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 12岁的安·沃伦（Miss Ann Warren）小姐。

**目击：** 1972年5月25日0900Z，目击者位于维多利亚10英里点（10 Mile Point）的一座山上的房子里。当时天气晴朗，能见度10英里，风力平静。

**后续：** 该报告由维多利亚救援协调中心发送至加拿大国家研究委员会和渥太华加拿大军队总部。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Andrew Dufrense (also spelled Dufense), Robert Ashmead, Earl R. Anderson, Lee Murphy, and Cecilia Murphy.

**Date / Time:** May 26, 1972; sightings began between 2:00 AM and 3:00 AM MST.

**Location:** Highway 35, north of Paddle Prairie, Alberta, continuing to the Murphy residence near High Level, Alberta.

**Sighting:** On May 26, 1972, at approximately 2:00–3:00 AM, a group of five witnesses traveling north on Highway 35 from Paddle Prairie observed an unidentified aerial phenomenon. Andrew Dufrense, Robert Ashmead, and Earl R. Anderson first encountered the object 5 miles north of Paddle Prairie. The object maintained a constant distance (estimated between 200 and 500 yards) and altitude (500 to 1,000 feet) relative to their vehicle. When the witnesses increased their speed to 85 mph, the object accelerated to match them, moving randomly from side to side across the road without ever falling behind.

While in transit, the witnesses contacted Lee Murphy via truck radio 15 miles south of High Level. Upon arriving at the Murphy residence at approximately 2:30 AM, Lee and Cecilia Murphy joined the others in observing the phenomenon. Witnesses reported that the object(s) appeared to divide or split into groups of 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6 pieces at random intervals. The objects were observed in the west, appearing to cluster together with one remaining separate. They were noted to appear and disappear frequently. The sighting lasted approximately one hour, ending when the objects departed rapidly toward the northwest in the direction of Footner Lake Airport. Earl Anderson attempted to track the objects with binoculars upon arriving home, but they had vanished.

**Object:** The objects were described as black, grayish-black, or oblong in shape, occasionally resembling clouds. Some accounts noted a tail-like feature on the left or right side. They possessed no lights, emitted no sound, and maintained an altitude of 500 to 1,000 feet. Their movement was characterized by rapid acceleration, random lateral shifts, and the ability to split into multiple distinct entities before disappearing.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The RCMP conducted an investigation led by Cst. R.D. Stair. Official inquiries were made with the Department of Transport at Footner Lake Airport, which confirmed no incoming traffic during the time of the sighting, though one light aircraft departed at 5:30 AM. Cst. Stair noted that the witnesses were local residents considered to be reliable, though one witness (Robert Ashmead) disclosed he had consumed approximately one dozen beers between noon on May 25 and the time of the sighting. A formal statement was taken on May 28, 1972, at 8:30 PM in High Level. R.D. Stair concluded the file by stating that no further investigation was required.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 安德鲁·杜弗伦斯（Andrew Dufrense，亦拼作 Dufense）、罗伯特·阿什米德（Robert Ashmead）、厄尔·R·安德森（Earl R. Anderson）、李·墨菲（Lee Murphy）以及塞西莉亚·墨菲（Cecilia Murphy）。

**日期 / 时间：** 1972年5月26日；目击事件始于山区标准时间（MST）凌晨2:00至3:00之间。

**地点：** 阿尔伯塔省帕德尔草原（Paddle Prairie）以北的35号公路，并延伸至阿尔伯塔省海莱弗尔（High Level）附近的墨菲住所。

**目击经过：** 1972年5月26日凌晨约2:00至3:00，五名目击者乘车沿35号公路从帕德尔草原向北行驶时，观察到一种不明空中现象。安德鲁·杜弗伦斯、罗伯特·阿什米德和厄尔·R·安德森在帕德尔草原以北5英里处首次遭遇该物体。该物体与他们的车辆保持着恒定的距离（估计在200至500码之间）和高度（500至1,000英尺）。当目击者将车速提高到每小时85英里时，该物体也随之加速以保持同步，并在道路两侧随机移动，始终未被甩在身后。

在行驶途中，目击者通过卡车无线电联系了位于海莱弗尔以南15英里的李·墨菲。大约凌晨2:30抵达墨菲住所后，李·墨菲和塞西莉亚·墨菲也加入了观察行列。据目击者报告，该物体（或多个物体）似乎会随机分裂成2、3、4、5或6个部分。这些物体出现在西方，看起来聚在一起，其中一个保持独立。据记录，它们频繁地出现又消失。目击过程持续了约一小时，最终这些物体迅速向西北方向的富特纳湖机场（Footner Lake Airport）飞去并消失。厄尔·安德森在回到家后曾试图用双筒望远镜追踪这些物体，但它们已经不见踪影。

**物体描述：** 这些物体被描述为黑色、灰黑色或长方形，有时看起来像云。一些描述提到其左侧或右侧有类似尾巴的特征。它们没有灯光，没有发出任何声音，并保持在500至1,000英尺的高度。其运动特点是快速加速、随机横向移动，并具有在消失前分裂成多个独立实体的能力。

**调查/后续：** 加拿大皇家骑警（RCMP）由R.D.斯泰尔（R.D. Stair）警官负责进行调查。官方对富特纳湖机场的交通部门进行了问询，确认在目击期间没有进港航班，仅有一架轻型飞机在凌晨5:30起飞。斯泰尔警官指出，目击者均为当地居民，被认为是可靠的，尽管其中一名目击者（罗伯特·阿什米德）透露他在5月25日中午至目击发生期间饮用了约一打啤酒。1972年5月28日晚8:30，警方在海莱弗尔获取了正式陈述。R.D.斯泰尔在结案报告中称，无需进行进一步调查。

**Witnesses:** Patrick Ralph Young.

**Sighting:** On May 26, 1972, at 22:50 Z, the observer reported a light seen from the Goose Bay Airport site. The weather was partly cloudy.

**Object:** The object was described as a "very bright" white dot, visible for 10 minutes. The position in the sky began at 2 degrees above the horizon at a bearing of 300 degrees and ended below the horizon.

**Aftermath:** The report includes a note stating the light was seen at a great distance and could have been a planet or comet. A further note dated June 1, 1972, suggests the object was likely Venus, which was approximately -3 magnitude in the western sky at sunset on that date.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 帕特里克·拉尔夫·杨 (Patrick Ralph Young)。

**日期：** 1972年5月26日，22:50 Z（祖鲁时间）。

**地点：** 鹅湾机场 (Goose Bay Airport)。

**目击经过：** 观察者报告称在鹅湾机场观测点看到了一道光。当时天气为局部多云。

**物体描述：** 该物体被描述为一个“非常明亮”的白点，可见时长为10分钟。其在天空中的位置始于地平线上方2度、方位角300度处，最终消失在地平线以下。

**调查/后续：** 报告中包含一条注释，指出该光点距离极远，可能是行星或彗星。1972年6月1日的一份后续记录表明，该物体极有可能是金星，当时金星位于西方天空，日落时亮度约为-3星等。

**Sighting:** On June 4, 1972, at 2318 local EDST, the observer reported seeing an object from the backyard of his home in St. Thomas, Ontario. The initial sighting was SSW from town, and the object tracked north.

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Bert Rupple 先生。

**目击：** 1972 年 6 月 4 日当地时间 23:18，目击者在安大略省圣托马斯市的家中后院报告了此次目击事件。最初的目击方向位于城镇的西南偏南，物体向北移动。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Fred Bare, Fred Bare’s daughter, Barney Enyedy, Matilda Enyedy, Mel Marshal, Don Repen, Gordon Delgatty, and Thomas Skelton.

**Date / Time:** June 10, 1972; sightings reported between 10:45 PM and 11:50 PM.

**Location:** Bonanza, Alberta.

**Sighting:** On the night of June 10, 1972, multiple residents in the Bonanza area reported anomalous aerial phenomena. At 10:45 PM, Fred Bare and his daughter observed an object approximately 8 miles northwest of Bonanza. The daughter initially mistook the object for a shooting star. Fred Bare reported that the object was positioned roughly 4 miles west of Bonanza at an altitude of 2,000 feet. He observed the object explode in mid-air, followed by the appearance of smoke.

Later that night, at 11:50 PM, a separate group consisting of Barney Enyedy, Matilda Enyedy, Mel Marshal, and Don Repen reported a different encounter. They observed an object hovering above them at an altitude of approximately 300 to 400 feet. This sighting lasted for about 5 minutes before the object faded and disappeared. The witnesses claimed that the object set fire to the ground directly beneath its hovering position.

**Object:** The descriptions provided by the witnesses varied significantly. Fred Bare described the object as having the intensity of a bright aircraft landing light. Conversely, the group including Barney Enyedy described the object as a round, highly illuminated circle featuring spikes all around its perimeter. They noted the object was bright red and emitted flames from its underside. Official investigation later identified the objects as three Navy C-3 hand-fired parachute flares.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The RCMP Spirit River Detachment conducted an investigation into the reports. While Barney Enyedy was the only member of his group interviewed by the RCMP at the time, the investigation eventually led to the identification of the source. Gordon Delgatty, a resident of Inuvik, NWT, admitted to firing the flares from the residence of Thomas Skelton in Bonanza. Delgatty, a former Navy serviceman, explained that he fired one flare during daylight hours and two additional flares after dark because he did not wish to transport the ordnance back to Inuvik. Following this admission, the RCMP concluded the investigation and sought guidance on whether further action was necessary. The RCMP had previously been instructed to advise Professor Folinsbee of the University of Alberta regarding the initial reports.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 弗雷德·贝尔（Fred Bare）、弗雷德·贝尔的女儿、巴尼·恩耶迪（Barney Enyedy）、玛蒂尔达·恩耶迪（Matilda Enyedy）、梅尔·马歇尔（Mel Marshal）、唐·雷彭（Don Repen）、戈登·德尔加蒂（Gordon Delgatty）以及托马斯·斯凯尔顿（Thomas Skelton）。

**日期 / 时间：** 1972年6月10日；目击报告时间介于晚上10:45至11:50之间。

**地点：** 阿尔伯塔省博南扎（Bonanza, Alberta）。

**目击经过：** 1972年6月10日晚，博南扎地区的几位居民报告了异常空中现象。晚上10:45，弗雷德·贝尔及其女儿在博南扎西北约8英里处观察到一个物体。起初，他的女儿误以为那是流星。弗雷德·贝尔称，该物体位于博南扎以西约4英里处，高度约为2000英尺。他观察到该物体在半空中爆炸，随后出现了烟雾。

当晚晚些时候，即晚上11:50，由巴尼·恩耶迪、玛蒂尔达·恩耶迪、梅尔·马歇尔和唐·雷彭组成的另一组人报告了不同的遭遇。他们观察到一个物体悬停在他们上方约300至400英尺的高度。这次目击持续了约5分钟，随后物体逐渐变淡并消失。目击者声称，该物体使其悬停位置正下方的地面起火。

**物体描述：** 目击者提供的描述差异很大。弗雷德·贝尔形容该物体具有明亮的飞机着陆灯强度。相反，包括巴尼·恩耶迪在内的小组则将该物体描述为一个圆形、高度发光的圆环，其周边带有尖刺。他们指出该物体呈亮红色，底部喷射出火焰。官方调查随后认定这些物体为三枚海军C-3手持式降落伞照明弹。

**调查/后续：** 加拿大皇家骑警（RCMP）斯皮里特河（Spirit River）分队对这些报告进行了调查。尽管当时巴尼·恩耶迪是其小组中唯一接受皇家骑警采访的成员，但调查最终确定了来源。来自西北地区伊努维克（Inuvik）的居民戈登·德尔加蒂承认，他在博南扎的托马斯·斯凯尔顿住所处发射了这些照明弹。德尔加蒂曾是一名海军军人，他解释说，由于不想将这些军火带回伊努维克，他在白天发射了一枚照明弹，天黑后又发射了两枚。在此供述后，皇家骑警结束了调查，并就是否有必要采取进一步行动寻求指导。皇家骑警此前曾接到指示，需将初步报告告知阿尔伯塔大学的福林斯比（Folinsbee）教授。

**Witnesses:** Lucien Daigle, Charles Bosse

**Date / Time:** June 24, 1972, at 8:30 PM

**Location:** One mile west of the Garden of the Republic Provincial Park, St. Jacques, Madawaska County, New Brunswick.

**Sighting:** On the evening of June 24, 1972, a UFO sighting was reported in St. Jacques, New Brunswick. Witness Charles Bosse observed an anomalous event at 8:30 PM while in an area one mile west of the Garden of the Republic Provincial Park. According to Bosse, the sky was cloudy at the time of the sighting. He reported seeing a very bright, red-orange fire that he estimated to be approximately the size of a motor vehicle. The object remained visible for a duration of two minutes, during which it traveled from the south-east to the north-west at an altitude estimated between 500 and 1,000 feet. Bosse noted that the object produced a distinct sound, which he described as resembling the discharge of a firearm.

**Object:** The object was described as a very bright, red-orange fire, roughly the size of a motor vehicle. It exhibited a steady movement from the south-east to the north-west at an altitude of 500 to 1,000 feet. The duration of the sighting was two minutes, and the object emitted a sound comparable to the discharge of a firearm. Official investigation later identified the object as a survival flare rocket.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** Following the report, an official investigation was conducted into the sighting in St. Jacques, Madawaska County. As part of the inquiry, local airports were contacted to determine if any aircraft were missing or in distress; all airports reported no missing planes. The investigation ultimately concluded that the object sighted was a survival flare rocket. It was determined that the flare had been discharged by Lucien Daigle, who served as a Steamship Inspector for the Department of Transport and was present at the location. Based on this identification, the file was closed with no further reports to follow.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 吕西安·戴格 (Lucien Daigle)、查尔斯·博塞 (Charles Bosse)

**日期 / 时间：** 1972年6月24日，晚上8:30

**地点：** 新不伦瑞克省马达瓦斯卡县圣雅克 (St. Jacques)，共和国花园省立公园以西一英里处。

**目击经过：** 1972年6月24日晚，新不伦瑞克省圣雅克发生了一起UFO目击事件。目击者查尔斯·博塞于晚上8:30在共和国花园省立公园以西一英里处观察到了这一异常现象。据博塞描述，当时天空多云。他报告称看到了一团非常明亮的红橙色火球，估计大小与一辆机动车相当。该物体持续可见两分钟，期间从东南方向向西北方向移动，飞行高度估计在500至1,000英尺之间。博塞指出，该物体发出了一种独特的声音，他形容其类似于枪支发射的声音。

**物体描述：** 该物体被描述为一团非常明亮的红橙色火球，大小约相当于一辆机动车。它以稳定的轨迹从东南向西北移动，高度在500至1,000英尺之间。目击持续时间为两分钟，物体发出了类似于枪支发射的声音。官方调查随后确认该物体为一枚求生信号弹。

**调查/后续：** 事件发生后，针对马达瓦斯卡县圣雅克的这起目击事件进行了官方调查。作为调查的一部分，相关部门联系了当地机场，以确定是否有飞机失踪或处于紧急状态；所有机场均报告没有飞机失踪。调查最终得出结论，所目击的物体是一枚求生信号弹。经查明，该信号弹是由当时在现场的交通部轮船检查员吕西安·戴格发射的。基于这一结论，该档案被结案，后续未再有相关报告。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mme Donna Mercer (Mrs. Leo Mercier), M. John Lunan (school principal), a journalist from *Le Droit*, a Glen Cairn housewife, Lawson Smith, approximately thirty local residents, and the OPP at Bells Corners.

**Date / Time:** July 18, 1972, between 12:25 AM and 02:30 AM EDT (with reports of a recurring light over four consecutive nights at 1:00 AM).

**Location:** Campbells Bay, QC; Glen Cairn (Kanata), ON; and surrounding regions including Chapeau, Westmeath, and Petawawa.

**Sighting:** On July 18, 1972, a significant wave of sightings occurred. Between 12:25 AM and 01:45 AM, Mrs. Leo Mercier and several others observed an object in the North. Simultaneously, in the Glen Cairn area of Kanata, a housewife reported an arrow-shaped object, while the OPP at Bells Corners received six calls between 1:00 AM and 2:30 AM regarding aerial phenomena. 

Mme Donna Mercer reported observing a mysterious light for four consecutive nights at 1:00 AM. This led to gatherings of approximately thirty people in her yard, including M. John Lunan and a journalist from *Le Droit*. M. Lunan observed the light through a telescope, noting it moved significantly faster than a satellite. While some reports were dismissed as potential crank calls, the OPP noted that most appeared legitimate. Similar sightings have been documented in the region over the previous three years, including reports in Chapeau, Westmeath, and Petawawa.

**Object:** Descriptions varied by witness and location. The object observed by Mrs. Mercier was star-like, approximately 3 feet across, and exhibited a "zigzag" motion before ascending. Its color shifted from orange to blue, accompanied by an "orange thrust." M. Lunan described the light as red at the top. The Glen Cairn housewife described an arrow-shaped object colored red and green. Mme Mercer described the object as a bright orange light, which she characterized as a "flying saucer."

**Investigation / Follow-up:** The sighting was reported to the Meteor Centre on July 19, 1972, by Mrs. Mary Gray of the Observatory Staff, with the message recorded by Mrs. Chénier. Local police (three officers) responded to Mme Mercer’s yard during the gatherings. A spokesperson at the weather office suggested the sightings might be related to the "northern lights" or "balls of lightning" reported the previous week at Campbells Bay. Lawson Smith, owner of the Pontiac Transit Mix gravel pit, suggested that the recurring orange light observed by Mme Mercer might be attributed to his welding equipment, though he noted that his equipment did not resemble the objects described by the residents. Historical context includes reports of circular burn marks found on the ground in Chapeau and Westmeath following previous sightings in those areas.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 唐娜·默瑟夫人（Donna Mercer，即 Leo Mercier 夫人）、约翰·卢南先生（John Lunan，校长）、一名来自《权利报》（*Le Droit*）的记者、一名格伦凯恩（Glen Cairn）的家庭主妇、劳森·史密斯（Lawson Smith）、约三十名当地居民，以及贝尔斯角（Bells Corners）的安大略省警察局（OPP）警员。

**日期 / 时间：** 1972年7月18日，美国东部时间凌晨12:25至凌晨02:30之间（据报告，在连续四个夜晚的凌晨1:00均出现了重复出现的光点）。

**地点：** 魁北克省坎贝尔湾（Campbells Bay）；安大略省格伦凯恩（卡纳塔）；以及包括沙波（Chapeau）、韦斯特米斯（Westmeath）和佩塔瓦瓦（Petawawa）在内的周边地区。

**目击经过：** 1972年7月18日，发生了一波重大的目击事件。凌晨12:25至01:45之间，Leo Mercier 夫人及其他几人观察到了北方的一个物体。与此同时，在卡纳塔的格伦凯恩地区，一名家庭主妇报告称看到了一个箭形的物体；而贝尔斯角的安大略省警察局在凌晨1:00至2:30之间接到了六个关于空中现象的报警电话。

唐娜·默瑟夫人报告称，连续四个夜晚的凌晨1:00都观察到了神秘的光点。这引得约三十人聚集在她的院子里，其中包括约翰·卢南先生和一名《权利报》的记者。卢南先生通过望远镜观察了该光点，指出其移动速度明显快于卫星。虽然一些报告被视为可能的恶作剧电话，但安大略省警察局指出，大多数报告看起来是真实的。过去三年里，该地区也记录过类似的目击事件，包括在沙波、韦斯特米斯和佩塔瓦瓦的报告。

**物体描述：** 不同目击者和地点的描述各不相同。Mercer 夫人观察到的物体呈星状，直径约3英尺，在上升前呈现出“之”字形运动。其颜色从橙色变为蓝色，并伴有“橙色的推力”。卢南先生描述该光点顶部为红色。格伦凯恩的家庭主妇描述该物体呈箭形，颜色为红绿相间。默瑟夫人则将该物体描述为明亮的橙色光点，并称其为“飞碟”。

**调查/后续：** 1972年7月19日，天文台工作人员玛丽·格雷（Mary Gray）夫人将此次目击事件报告给了流星中心，并由谢尼耶（Chénier）夫人记录了相关信息。在聚集期间，当地警方（三名警官）曾前往默瑟夫人的院子进行响应。气象局的一位发言人建议，这些目击事件可能与前一周在坎贝尔湾报告的“北极光”或“球状闪电”有关。庞蒂亚克搅拌站（Pontiac Transit Mix）砂石坑的所有者劳森·史密斯表示，默瑟夫人观察到的重复出现的橙色光点可能归因于他的焊接设备，但他同时也指出，他的设备与居民们描述的物体并不相似。历史背景包括在沙波和韦斯特米斯，此前目击事件后曾在地面上发现过圆形灼烧痕迹。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mr. Jim McGregor, Mrs. McGregor, Mrs. William Laws, Perry Laws, Gerllaune Laws, Mr. R. Bouchard.

**Date / Time:** July 28, 1972. Specific times reported include 02:10 and 05:00.

**Location:** Hanmer, Ontario (specifically 4286 Theresa Street and 4186 Roy Avenue).

**Sighting:** 
The Hanmer, Ontario sightings of July 28, 1972, involved multiple reports from residents in the area. According to the report involving Mr. Jim McGregor, Mrs. McGregor, and Mr. R. Bouchard at 4286 Theresa Street, the witnesses observed a very large, oblong-shaped object on a clear, starlight night. This object featured alternating flashing green, red, and white lights. It was observed at a very high altitude and appeared to decrease in size as it moved due west over a duration of 40 minutes.

A separate report involving Mr. Jim McGregor, Mrs. William Laws, Perry Laws, and Gerllaune Laws (of 4186 Roy Ave) details two distinct observations. The first occurred at 05:00, involving an object displaying flashing red, green, and white lights that headed south-westerly for a duration of 1 hour and 40 minutes. The second observation by this group occurred at 02:10, involving a round white object observed at an altitude of 1,000 feet for a duration of 3 minutes; this object was noted for having bright lights on its bottom.

**Object:** 
The sightings involved two distinct object descriptions. The first was a very large, oblong-shaped craft featuring alternating flashing green, red, and white lights, which appeared to be at a high altitude and moved due west. The second was a round, white object observed at 1,000 feet, characterized by bright lights on its underside. Movement varied between a south-westerly trajectory and a westward path, with durations ranging from 3 minutes to 1 hour and 40 minutes.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** 
The reports were officially documented and transmitted via telex to the National Research Council (NRC) Radio and Electrical Engineering Division. Meteorological data was obtained from the Sudbury Met Office for the time of the sightings, confirming clear skies, a temperature of 50 degrees Fahrenheit, and winds blowing from 310 degrees at 5 mph.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 吉姆·麦格雷戈先生 (Mr. Jim McGregor)、麦格雷戈夫人 (Mrs. McGregor)、威廉·劳斯夫人 (Mrs. William Laws)、佩里·劳斯 (Perry Laws)、格劳恩·劳斯 (Gerllaune Laws)、R. 布沙尔先生 (Mr. R. Bouchard)。

**日期 / 时间：** 1972年7月28日。报告的具体时间包括凌晨02:10和05:00。

**地点：** 安大略省汉默（具体为特蕾莎街4286号和罗伊大道4186号）。

**目击经过：** 
1972年7月28日发生在安大略省汉默的目击事件涉及当地居民的多份报告。根据特蕾莎街4286号的吉姆·麦格雷戈先生、麦格雷戈夫人和R. 布沙尔先生的报告，目击者在一个晴朗的星夜观察到一个非常巨大的长方形物体。该物体闪烁着交替的绿色、红色和白色灯光。它在极高的高度被观测到，并在向正西方向移动的过程中，持续40分钟后看起来体积逐渐变小。

另一份涉及吉姆·麦格雷戈先生、威廉·劳斯夫人、佩里·劳斯和格劳恩·劳斯（罗伊大道4186号）的报告详细描述了两次不同的观测。第一次发生在05:00，涉及一个闪烁着红、绿、白灯光的物体，它向西南方向移动，持续时间为1小时40分钟。该小组的第二次观测发生在02:10，涉及一个圆形的白色物体，在1000英尺的高度被观测到，持续时间为3分钟；该物体的底部有明亮的灯光。

**物体描述：** 
此次目击事件涉及两种不同的物体描述。第一种是一个非常巨大的长方形飞行器，带有交替闪烁的绿、红、白灯光，似乎处于高空并向正西方向移动。第二种是一个圆形的白色物体，在1000英尺高度被观测到，其特征是底部有明亮的灯光。物体的移动轨迹在西南方向和正西方向之间变化，持续时间从3分钟到1小时40分钟不等。

**调查/后续：** 
这些报告已被正式记录，并通过电传方式发送至加拿大国家研究委员会（NRC）无线电与电气工程部。调查人员从萨德伯里气象局获取了目击时间段的气象数据，证实当时天空晴朗，气温为华氏50度（约摄氏10度），风向为310度，风速为每小时5英里。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** An unnamed observer (refused identification), Mr. A. Tarsiuk, and Mrs. Tarsiuk.

**Date / Time:** July 26, 1972 (Tarsiuk sighting) and July 27, 1972, at 0550Z (Unnamed observer sighting).

**Location:** Grande Prairie and Sexsmith, Alberta.

**Sighting:** 
The case file documents two distinct reports regarding aerial phenomena in the Grande Prairie/Sexsmith area. 

On July 26, 1972, Mr. and Mrs. Tarsiuk, located at 10210 - 111 Ave in Grande Prairie, observed an object positioned 15 to 20 degrees above the horizon to the south of the city. The object traveled toward the southwest and remained visible for approximately 30 minutes before disappearing into a cloudy horizon.

On July 27, 1972, at 0550Z, an unnamed observer who declined to provide identification reported a separate sighting. This individual observed a single object flying at a high altitude northeast of the town of Sexsmith, heading in an easterly direction. This sighting also lasted for approximately 30 minutes.

**Object:** 
The descriptions provided by the witnesses differ in detail. Mr. and Mrs. Tarsiuk, utilizing binoculars, described the object as appearing the size of a headlight. It featured a dark center surrounded by a green outer ring and maintained a constant altitude throughout the observation. 

The unnamed observer described the object as displaying unsteady red and green lights while in flight.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** 
The Tarsiuk report was formally transmitted to the National Research Council in Ottawa for further review. 

Regarding the July 27 sighting, official inquiries were conducted to correlate the report with known air traffic. Grande Prairie Airport control confirmed that there were no aircraft scheduled or reported flying in the area at the time of the sighting. However, radar data did detect a single contact in the vicinity. This radar contact was tracked heading at 120 degrees at an altitude of 4,800 feet, moving at a slow rate of speed. The radar contact was eventually lost at a distance of 195 miles at 0626Z.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 一名未具名观察者（拒绝透露身份）、A. 塔修克先生（Mr. A. Tarsiuk）及塔修克夫人（Mrs. Tarsiuk）。

**日期 / 时间：** 1972年7月26日（塔修克夫妇目击事件）及1972年7月27日0550Z（未具名观察者目击事件）。

**地点：** 阿尔伯塔省大草原城（Grande Prairie）及塞克斯史密斯（Sexsmith）。

**目击经过：**
该档案记录了关于大草原城/塞克斯史密斯地区空中现象的两起独立报告。

1972年7月26日，位于大草原城111大道10210号的塔修克夫妇观察到一个位于城市南部、地平线上方15至20度位置的物体。该物体向西南方向移动，在消失于多云的地平线之前，可见时间持续了约30分钟。

1972年7月27日0550Z，一名拒绝提供身份信息的未具名观察者报告了另一起目击事件。该目击者观察到一个单一物体在塞克斯史密斯镇东北方的高空飞行，航向为正东。此次目击过程同样持续了约30分钟。

**物体描述：**
目击者提供的描述在细节上有所不同。塔修克夫妇通过双筒望远镜观察，称该物体看起来像车前灯大小。它中心呈暗色，外围环绕着绿色光圈，在整个观察过程中保持高度不变。

未具名观察者则描述称，该物体在飞行时闪烁着不稳定的红光和绿光。

**调查/后续：**
塔修克夫妇的报告已被正式转交至渥太华的国家研究委员会（National Research Council）进行进一步审查。

关于7月27日的目击事件，官方进行了调查以核实该报告是否与已知空中交通有关。大草原城机场管制部门确认，在目击事件发生时，该地区没有预定或报告的飞行器。然而，雷达数据确实在该区域探测到了一个单一目标。该雷达目标被追踪到以120度航向、4800英尺高度缓慢飞行。该雷达目标最终于0626Z在195英里外消失。

**Witnesses:** Mr. Hewlitt (also identified as Mr. Hewlitt RC)

**Date / Time:** August 6, 1972, at 0540Z

**Location:** 674 Cowan St, Kamloops, BC

**Sighting:** 
On August 6, 1972, at 0540Z, Mr. Hewlitt observed an unidentified aerial phenomenon in the skies over Kamloops, British Columbia. The sighting lasted for a total duration of 10 minutes. At the time of the observation, the sky conditions were noted as having thin cloud cover. Mr. Hewlitt tracked the object as it moved in an easterly and northerly direction. The object was first sighted at a bearing of 350 degrees and maintained visibility until last contact at 015 degrees. Throughout the duration of the event, the object remained at an approximate 80-degree angle relative to the horizon.

**Object:** 
The object was described as being small in size. Its color was noted as amber to orange. While the specific altitude of the object could not be determined, it was observed at a high elevation (80-degree angle). No sound or specific structural details were reported beyond its color, size, and trajectory.

**Investigation / Follow-up:** 
The sighting was formally documented and transmitted from CANDEFRAD Kamloops to the RCCWC/CANFORCEHED (Canadian Forces Headquarters) and the National Research Council Radio and Electrical Engineering Division. The documentation includes the witness's specific address at 674 Cowan St, Kamloops, BC. Official records note that the documentation provided across the files is considered a suspected duplicate of the same event.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 休利特先生（Hewlitt，亦被记录为休利特 RC 先生）

**日期 / 时间：** 1972年8月6日，0540Z（协调世界时）

**地点：** 不列颠哥伦比亚省坎卢普斯市考恩街674号

**目击经过：** 
1972年8月6日0540Z，休利特先生在不列颠哥伦比亚省坎卢普斯市上空观测到一个不明空中现象。此次目击事件持续了10分钟。观测时，天空状况为薄云覆盖。休利特先生追踪了该物体的移动轨迹，其移动方向为东向及北向。该物体最初在350度方位角被发现，并保持可见状态，直至015度方位角时最后一次观测到。在整个事件过程中，该物体相对于地平线保持在大约80度的仰角。

**物体描述：** 
该物体被描述为体积较小。其颜色为琥珀色至橙色。虽然无法确定该物体的具体高度，但观测显示其处于高海拔位置（80度仰角）。除颜色、大小和轨迹外，未报告任何声音或具体的结构细节。

**调查/后续：** 
此次目击事件已正式记录在案，并由坎卢普斯加拿大国防部（CANDEFRAD）转交至加拿大搜救协调中心（RCCWC）/加拿大武装部队总部（CANFORCEHED）以及加拿大国家研究委员会无线电与电气工程部。相关文档中包含了目击者的具体地址（坎卢普斯市考恩街674号）。官方记录指出，各档案中提供的相关文档被认为是同一事件的疑似重复记录。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Marcel Lebrun and his brother, René, residents of Vanier, Ontario.

**Sighting:** On July 1, 1972, between 10:30 and 10:45 EDT, the witnesses were driving on a road to a cottage at Lac Ste. Claire, P.Q., approximately 15 miles from the main highway. The weather was very clear on a moonlit night with no planes observed.

**Object:** The witnesses observed a stationary, rectangular object in the forest, approximately 1/4 mile from their car and 40 feet off the ground. The object was described as looking like a giant TV screen and was flashing all sorts of colours. The witnesses stopped their car and turned off the headlights to observe the object for 4 or 5 minutes.

**Aftermath:** The report was telephoned to the office on August 15, 1972, with additional information provided on August 16, 1972. The message was taken by MM and CC.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Marcel Lebrun 和他的兄弟 René，居住于安大略省 Vanier。

**目击：** 1972年7月1日，EDT时间 10:30 至 10:45，见证者正驾车前往位于魁北克省 Lac Ste. Claire 的小屋，距离主干道约15英里。当时天气非常晴朗，月光皎洁，未见飞机。

**物体：** 见证者在森林中观察到一个静止的矩形物体，距离汽车约1/4英里，离地约40英尺。该物体被描述为看起来像一个巨大的电视屏幕，并闪烁着各种颜色。见证者停车并关闭了车头灯，观察了该物体4到5分钟。

**后续：** 该报告于1972年8月15日通过电话传达至办公室，并于8月16日提供了更多信息。消息由 MM 和 CC 记录。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** D. Roy.

**Sighting:** The witness reported seeing an object at 11:00 P.M. during the first week of July. The object was observed west of the witness, above the tree line, over the lake.

**Object:** The object was described as a yellow-orange ball, spherical in shape, and approximately the size of a harvest moon. It was seen against wispy clouds. The duration of the sighting was 5 to 10 minutes.

**Aftermath:** The witness noted that the object was gone when they returned. An official note suggests the sighting may have been a section of the first quarter moon seen between layers in a hazy atmosphere, noting that the moon looked deep orange and very large at 10:30 P.M. on a subsequent night.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** D. Roy。

**目击：** 目击者报告称在7月的第一周晚上11:00看到一个物体。该物体位于目击者西侧，树线以上，湖面上空。

**物体：** 该物体被描述为一个黄橙色的球体，形状呈球形，大小约为收获月亮的大小。它出现在薄云背景下。目击持续时间为5到10分钟。

**后续：** 目击者指出当他们返回时物体已经消失。官方备注建议此次目击可能是在朦胧大气层中看到的上弦月的一部分，并提到在随后的夜晚10:30，月亮看起来呈深橙色且非常大。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mrs. DC Denny.

**Sighting:** The event occurred at 0430 hours on August 22, 1972, at the residence of the Ski-Ways Pine River Chalet in Mansfield, Ontario. The object was observed for a duration of 25 minutes.

**Object:** The object was described as being larger and much brighter than a star, and it remained stationary in the sky to the northwest of Mansfield.

**Aftermath:** The object was first observed due to its reflection in a pond located behind the residence.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** DC Denny 夫人。

**目击：** 事件发生于 1972 年 8 月 22 日 04:30，地点位于安大略省曼斯菲尔德的 Ski-Ways Pine River Chalet 住所。观测持续了 25 分钟。

**物体：** 该物体被描述为比星星更大且更亮，在曼斯菲尔德西北方的天空中保持静止。

**后续：** 该物体最初是因为在住所后方的池塘中产生反射而被发现。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Cpl (A) Wilson and Cpl (A) Merrick, who are employed as an Air Defence Technician and a Refrigeration and Mechanical Technician respectively at the unit.

**Sighting:** On August 24, 1972, at 0520Z, the observers reported an object while the sky was clear with a full moon. The location was 635 William St, Beausejour, Manitoba. The sighting lasted for one hour.

**Object:** The object was described as oval-shaped with four colored lights (red, green, green, red) in a row. It was stationary and large in relation to a jet airliner en route. It was estimated to be at 270 degrees, 80 miles away at 35,000 feet, though observers noted it could have been higher and farther depending on its size.

**Aftermath:** The observers contacted CFS Beausejour to request a radar (search and height finder) check. There was a nil return on radar. The observers stated the object was definitely not an aircraft or a weather balloon.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Wilson 下士（A）和 Merrick 下士（A），他们分别是该单位的防空技术员以及制冷和机械技术员。

**目击：** 1972年8月24日 0520Z，目击者在天空晴朗且有满月的情况下报告了该物体。地点位于曼尼托巴省博塞茹尔（Beausejour）威廉街635号。目击持续了一小时。

**物体：** 该物体被描述为椭圆形，带有四个排成一行的彩色灯光（红、绿、绿、红）。物体处于静止状态，相对于航线上的喷气式客机来说很大。据估计，该物体位于270度方向，距离80英里，高度35,000英尺，但观察者指出，根据其大小，它可能更高、更远。

**后续：** 观察者联系了博塞茹尔加拿大部队基地（CFS Beausejour）请求进行雷达（搜索和高度测定）检查。雷达显示无回波。观察者声称该物体绝对不是飞机或气象气球。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mr. MacBride, his wife, and an unknown neighbor.

**Sighting:** On August 27, 1972, at approximately 03:45, a stationary object was observed for a minimum of one hour. The sighting occurred during a smoke and fog inversion at 50 feet above ground level.

**Object:** The object displayed flashing red and green lights, as well as bright yellow light, appearing at regular intervals.

**Aftermath:** Three controllers in the tower at Winnipeg International Airport, located approximately four miles away, were unable to confirm the sighting. They suggested that the lights were reflections caused by the inversion. Mr. MacBride was contacted and informed of this assessment.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** MacBride 先生、他的妻子以及一位身份不明的邻居。

**目击：** 1972 年 8 月 27 日凌晨 3 点 45 分左右，目击者观察到一个静止物体长达至少一小时。当时地面上方 50 英尺处存在烟雾和雾气逆温现象。

**物体：** 该物体显示出闪烁的红色和绿色灯光，以及明亮的黄色灯光，并以固定的时间间隔出现。

**后续：** 位于约四英里外的温尼伯国际机场塔台的三名管制员无法证实此次目击事件。他们认为这些光线是由逆温引起的反射。相关人员已联系 MacBride 先生并告知了这一评估结果。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** The undersigned.

**Sighting:** On August 28, 1972, at 280400Z, a sighting occurred in Dauphin, Manitoba, under cloudy conditions.

**Object:** The object was described as having the brightness of the moon, a bright yellow color, and the size of the sun. It appeared approximately 20 degrees above the horizon.

**Aftermath:** The object produced approximately four bright consecutive momentary flashes. The report notes that the moon was the only other observation at the same time and location.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 签署人。

**目击：** 1972年8月28日（280400Z），在曼尼托巴省多芬市，天气多云。

**物体：** 该物体亮度如月亮，颜色为亮黄色，大小如太阳。它出现在地平线上方约20度处。

**后续：** 该物体产生了大约四次明亮的连续瞬间闪光。报告指出，当时同一地点唯一的其他观测对象是月亮。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Greg Faltersack, an 18-year-old youth.

**Sighting:** While driving home from visiting his girlfriend at approximately 2:30 a.m. on a county road in the northeastern part of Waukesha County, the witness experienced a complete electrical failure in his car. Upon applying his brakes, the car skidded 23 feet. After exiting the vehicle, the witness observed a large, orange object approximately 20 feet in diameter hovering about 40 feet above him at tree-top level. The object emitted a "beep, beep" sound before disappearing.

**Object:** A large, orange object, approximately 20 feet in diameter.

**Aftermath:** The witness reported the incident to the Waukesha County Sheriff's Department. Sgt. Herman Sprung stated that the witness seemed sincere and shaken. An inspection of the vehicle confirmed the witness's report, noting that the water in the car had boiled over, the fuse box had been blown out, and there were skid marks on the road. Sgt. Sprung stated that the department was not discounting the report as a hoax.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** 18岁青年 Greg Faltersack。

**目击：** 当事人于凌晨2:30左右在沃基肖县（Waukesha County）东北部的乡村道路上驾车回家时，车辆发生完全电气故障。在刹车后，车辆滑行了23英尺。当事人下车后，看到一个直径约20英尺的巨大橙色物体悬浮在离他约40英尺高的树梢上方。该物体发出“哔、哔”声后消失。

**物体：** 一个直径约20英尺的巨大橙色物体。

**后续：** 当事人向沃基肖县治安官部门报告了此事件。警官 Herman Sprung 表示，当事人看起来很真诚且受到惊吓。对车辆的检查证实了当事人的报告，发现车内水已沸腾、保险丝盒被烧毁，且路面上有刹车痕迹。Sprung 警官表示，该部门并未将此报告视为恶作剧。

CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary:
**Witnesses:** Mr. Denis Thul, four unnamed friends, and the President of Anglo Roulyn Mines.

**Sighting:** The page details two separate sighting areas. Area One (Caron, Mortlach, Parkbeg) involved sightings on September 10 and 11, 1972, with clear visibility and overcast conditions. Area Two (La Ronge) involved sightings over five consecutive nights between September 3 and September 9, and again on September 14.

**Object:** In Area One, the object was described as a dull white light with a reddish tinge that moved toward the witnesses before reversing course and moving away. In Area Two, the object was described as football-shaped with green, red, and blue lights.

**Aftermath:** The reports were transmitted via teletype from CANFORBASE Moose Jaw to RCCVC/NRC Ottawa for the Radio and Electrical Engineering Division.
CA-FOIA-Canada_-_FOIA_Part_06_-_Pages_15.report_summary_zh:
**见证者：** Denis Thul 先生、四位未具名的朋友，以及 Anglo Roulyn 矿业公司总裁。

**目击：** 该页面详细记录了两个独立的目击区域。区域一（Caron、Mortlach、Parkbeg）涉及 1972 年 9 月 10 日和 11 日的目击事件，当时天气状况包括晴朗和阴天。区域二（La Ronge）涉及 9 月 3 日至 9 月 9 日连续五晚的目击，以及 9 月 14 日的另一次目击。

**物体：** 在区域一，物体被描述为带有微红色的暗白色光，它向见证者移动，随后改变航向并离开。在区域二，物体被描述为橄榄球形状，带有绿色、红色和蓝色的灯光。

**后续：** 这些报告通过电传打字机从 Moose Jaw 加拿大军队基地发送至渥太华的 RCCVC/NRC 无线电与电气工程部门。
